163: FILE_EACH_LIMIT = 12  # records per file_each action
164: FILE_EACH_SECONDS = 150  # and seconds for all of them; the agent continues from the list afterwards

168: def batch_hint(counter: dict, kind: str, filed: bool) -> str:
169:     """Suggest the file_each batch action once an agent files the same kind of page one by one.
170: 
171:     `counter` maps kind -> consecutive filings (mutated). Returns the hint text, or "". Fires
172:     exactly once per streak so it costs one line, not a nag on every turn. The model still
173:     decides; nothing here assumes what any website looks like."""
174:     if not filed or not kind:
175:         return ""
176:     counter[kind] = counter.get(kind, 0) + 1
177:     for other in [key for key in counter if key != kind]:
178:         counter.pop(other, None)
179:     if counter[kind] == BATCH_NUDGE_AFTER:
180:         return ("; you have now filed several pages of this kind one by one — if the list they came "
181:                 "from still shows more records of the same kind, go back to that list and file the "
182:                 "rest together with one file_each (naming the records and the tabs that hold the facts)")
183:     return ""

186: async def file_each(tab, action: dict, file, saw, deadline: float, seen: str = "") -> str:
187:     """The file_each action: the model names several records on the page in front of it (links by id) and, if each
188:     record has tabs that matter, the tabs by label; code opens every record and tab and files it with the kind the
189:     model gave, then goes back to the list. The model chooses the records and kinds, as with keep; this only saves
190:     one model turn per page opened (the ERP agent needed 58-85 turns per run, each resending its whole prompt)."""
191:     kind = str(action.get("kind") or "")
192:     tabs = [t for t in (action.get("tabs") or []) if isinstance(t, dict) and (t.get("tab") or t.get("path"))]
193:     links = [str(i).strip("[] ") for i in (action.get("links") or [])][:FILE_EACH_LIMIT]
194:     if not links or not kind:
195:         return 'file_each needs "links" (ids of the records on this page) and "kind"'
196:     home = tab.page.url
197:     # The ids and link targets of the page the model saw when it chose (`seen`); a fresh read could number the
198:     # elements differently (a list that loads or reorders), and the wrong record would be filed.
199:     page = seen or await tab.observe()
200:     targets = {m.group(1): (m.group(3), (re.search(r"->\s*(\S+)", m.group(4)) or [None, None])[1])
201:                for m in CONTROL.finditer(page) if m.group(2) in ("link", "clickable")}
202:     first = True
203:     stop_at = min(deadline, time.time() + FILE_EACH_SECONDS)
204:     report = []
205:     for aid in links:
206:         if time.time() > stop_at:
207:             report.append(f"[{aid}] not opened: time for this action is up; file the rest with another file_each")
208:             continue
209:         label, href = targets.get(aid, (None, None))
210:         if label is None:
211:             report.append(f"[{aid}] is not a link on this page")
212:             continue
213:         if not href and not first:  # a link without an address: find it again by its label on the list as it is now
214:             if tab.page.url != home:
215:                 await tab.goto(home)
216:             aid_now, why = find_control(await tab.observe(), label, ("link", "clickable"))
217:             if aid_now is None:
218:                 report.append(f'[{aid}] "{label}" not opened: {why}')
219:                 continue
220:             aid = aid_now
221:         first = False
222:         opened = await (tab.goto(href) if href else tab.click(aid))
223:         record = await tab.observe()
224:         saw(record)
225:         if tab.page.url == home:  # nothing opened (a control that filters or sorts the list): nothing to file
226:             report.append(f'[{aid}] "{label}" did not open a record ({opened[:60]})')
227:             continue
228:         filed = [f"{kind}: {file(kind, tab.document, tab.document_source)[:120]}"]
229:         record_url = tab.page.url
230:         for extra in tabs:
231:             # A tab, or a path of controls clicked one after another (a stock overview, then a plant, then a
232:             # storage location); the page at its end is filed. Every control is looked up by its label on the page
233:             # as it is then (ids change with every page). If the first one is not on the page, back to the record.
234:             path = [str(step) for step in (extra.get("path") or [extra.get("tab")]) if step][:6]
235:             name = " > ".join(path)
236:             missing = None
237:             for number, step in enumerate(path):
238:                 now = await tab.observe()
239:                 control, why = find_control(now, step, ("link", "button", "clickable"))
240:                 if control is None and number == 0 and tab.page.url != record_url:
241:                     await tab.goto(record_url)
242:                     now = await tab.observe()
243:                     control, why = find_control(now, step, ("link", "button", "clickable"))
244:                 if control is None:
245:                     missing = f'"{name}": {why}'
246:                     break
247:                 href_tab = next((m.group(4) for m in CONTROL.finditer(now) if m.group(1) == control), "")
248:                 target = re.search(r"->\s*(\S+)", href_tab or "")
249:                 await (tab.goto(target.group(1)) if target else tab.click(control))
250:             if missing:
251:                 filed.append(missing)
252:                 continue
253:             saw(await tab.observe())
254:             tab_kind = str(extra.get("kind") or kind)
255:             filed.append(f'"{name}" as {tab_kind}: {file(tab_kind, tab.document, tab.document_source)[:120]}')
256:         report.append(f'[{aid}] "{label}" ({opened[:60]}): ' + "; ".join(filed))
257:     await tab.goto(home)
258:     return f"file_each opened {len(links)} record(s) and is back on the list:\n" + "\n".join(report)

261: def investigator(case: CaseFile, team: Team, tab: Tab, deadline: float) -> Agent:
262:     name = tab.site_id
263:     system = INVESTIGATOR.format(site=name, url=tab.base_url, brief=case.brief, actions=ACTIONS_HELP)

265:     def briefing() -> str:

270:         if news:
271:             text += "\n\nNEWS FROM YOUR FILED DOCUMENTS\n" + "\n".join(f"- {item}" for item in news)
272:         own_pending = case.pending_for(name)
273:         if own_pending:
274:             text += f"\n\n({own_pending} filed document(s) are still being read.)"
275:         elif case.pending:
276:             text += f"\n\n({case.pending} document(s) filed by other agents are still being read.)"

284:         document, source = agent.document()

315:                               "goto, or use the search form on the page. If the "
316:                               "page in front of you is a candidate record, file it with keep now, also when it seems "
317:                               "not to match: the case file does the matching, and requirement values can still change "

323: # Which website plays which role in this run, as the model read it from the brief (solve). The private dataset uses
324: # other site names, so routing goes by role first and falls back to the public site names only without one.
325: SITE_ROLES: dict[str, str] = {}
326: # Routed questions their own agent left open after it finished, with nothing still being read: offered to every agent
327: # from then on. The routing assumes the public split of facts (materials in the ERP, keys and approvals in the mail);
328: # the private dataset may split them differently, and a routed question must not end up with nobody to answer it.

332: def site_role(site_id: str) -> str | None:
333:     """"erp" or "mail" for the agent whose questions are routed, None for one that sees every question."""
334:     site = site_id.casefold()
335:     for role in ("erp", "mail"):
336:         named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
337:         if (site == named) if named else (role in site):
338:             return role
339:     return None

342: def questions_for_site(site_id: str, questions: list[tuple[str, str]]) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
343:     """Keep specialized mail and ERP agents on questions their portal can resolve (from Vamshidhar's v1 package,
344:     sandbox run 44a626ef: 100 in 9.6 min, every agent finished by itself)."""
345:     site = site_id.casefold()
346: 
347:     def plays(role: str) -> bool:
348:         named = (SITE_ROLES.get(role) or "").casefold()
349:         return site == named if named else role in site
350: 
351:     if plays("erp"):
352:         prefixes = ("material:", "data:")
353:         return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions if qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]
354:     if plays("mail"):
355:         prefixes = ("condition_group:", "packaging_tariff:", "delivery_commitment:", "setup_pool:",
356:                     "project_bonus:", "index:", "fx:", "reserve:")
357:         return [(qid, text) for qid, text in questions
358:                 if qid in ("mailbox", "discount") or qid.startswith(prefixes) or qid in RELEASED]

363:     """One tab per website: a browser each while the run has enough of them, else further tabs in the last one."""
364:     count = max(1, len(browsers.cdp_urls()) or min(len(sites), 4))
365:     opened, tabs, pages = [], {}, []
366:     for number in range(min(count, len(sites))):
367:         browser, page = await browsers.connect(playwright, number)
368:         opened.append(browser)
369:         pages.append(page)
370:     for index, site in enumerate(sites):
371:         page = pages[index] if index < len(pages) else await pages[-1].context.new_page()
372:         tabs[site["siteId"]] = Tab(page, site)
373:     for tab in tabs.values():  # where a tab may move when its own browser cannot load its website (Tab.renew)

1: """The run contract: read the run (the brief, the websites and their logins, where the answer goes), submit the answer.
2: 
3: In a test run or a scored run the platform sets CHALLENGE_API_URL and CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN. On your own machine there
4: is no run token: `eval "$(atira scout --env)"` exports the public scouting run as CHALLENGE_SCOUTING instead, and
5: nothing done with those logins counts. Docs: $API/docs/run-contract.md
6: """
7: import json
8: import os
9: import time
10: from urllib.error import HTTPError, URLError
11: from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
12: 
13: USER_AGENT = "atira-starter-kit/3"  # the API's edge refuses Python's default urllib agent
14: LOAD_SCOUTING = 'eval "$(atira scout --env)"; in PowerShell: atira scout --env | Out-String | Invoke-Expression'
15: 
16: 
17: def http(url: str, token: str | None = None, payload: dict | None = None, timeout: float = 30) -> tuple[int, str]:
18:     """GET (or POST `payload` as JSON) with the run token in x-api-key: the status and the body."""
19:     headers = {"Accept": "application/json", "User-Agent": USER_AGENT}
20:     if token:
21:         headers["x-api-key"] = token
22:     data = None
23:     if payload is not None:
24:         data = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False).encode()
25:         headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
26:     try:
27:         with urlopen(Request(url, data=data, headers=headers), timeout=timeout) as response:
28:             return response.status, response.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
29:     except HTTPError as error:
30:         return error.code, error.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
31: 
32: 
33: def load_run(env=os.environ) -> tuple[dict, str | None]:
34:     """The run and its token; locally, without a token, the scouting run that `atira scout --env` exported.
35: 
36:     The run has `brief` (the task and its rules, markdown), `access` (per website: `siteId`, `url`, `credentials`),
37:     `submission` (`kind` "api" or "site", and its `url`), `answer_schema`, `started_at` and `expires_at`.
38:     """
39:     token = env.get("CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN")
40:     if not token:
41:         if not env.get("CHALLENGE_SCOUTING"):
42:             raise SystemExit(f"No run token and no scouting logins. To develop locally: {LOAD_SCOUTING}")
43:         try:
44:             return json.loads(env["CHALLENGE_SCOUTING"]), None
45:         except ValueError:
46:             raise SystemExit(f"CHALLENGE_SCOUTING is not the JSON atira exports. Load it again: {LOAD_SCOUTING}")
47:     url = env["CHALLENGE_API_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/runs/current"
48:     status, body = 0, ""
49:     for attempt in range(5):  # rides out a restart of the API
50:         try:
51:             status, body = http(url, token)
52:         except (URLError, OSError) as error:
53:             status, body = 0, str(error)
54:         if status == 200:
55:             return json.loads(body), token
56:         if status in (401, 403, 404):  # the run is over, or the token is wrong: no point in asking again
57:             break
58:         time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
59:     raise SystemExit(f"Cannot read the run: HTTP {status} {body[:300]}")
60: 
61: 
62: def seconds_left(run: dict, now: float | None = None) -> float:
63:     """Seconds until the run's `expires_at` (epoch milliseconds); after that the answer is refused and the run scores
64:     0. Every part of the answer scores on its own, so submit your best answer about a minute before time runs out
65:     rather than keep searching."""
66:     expires_at = run.get("expires_at")
67:     if not expires_at:
68:         return float("inf")
69:     return expires_at / 1000 - (time.time() if now is None else now)
70: 
71: 
72: def submit_answer(run: dict, token: str | None, answer: dict) -> tuple[int, str]:
73:     """POST the answer to the run's "api" submission target. 202: accepted and final, the run ends. 400: the body
74:     lists the issues; nothing is recorded, fix the answer and send it again. A "site" submission is entered on that
75:     website instead, and the website confirms it with a receipt."""
76:     submission = run["submission"]
77:     if submission.get("kind") != "api":
78:         raise ValueError(f"This run takes its answer on the website {submission.get('url')}, not through the API")
79:     if not token:
80:         raise ValueError("No run to answer: locally there is no run token. Test it in a run: atira test-run .")
81:     return http(run.get("answer_url") or submission["url"], token, answer, timeout=60)

1: """The agent loop: a model reads a browser tab as text, decides what to do next, and acts.
2: 
3: One `Agent` drives one `Tab`. Each turn the model gets its briefing, what its last actions did and the current page,
4: and answers with a thought and a short list of actions. The loop only carries those out; where to go, what to
5: search for, which record matters and when the job is finished are the model's calls.
6: """
7: from __future__ import annotations
8: 
9: import asyncio
10: import hashlib
11: import json
12: import os
13: import re
14: import time
15: from typing import Awaitable, Callable
16: 
17: import llm
18: import sanity
19: from browser_env import NOT_KEPT, Tab
20: from coverage import Ledger
21: 
22: ACTIONS_HELP = """Reply with ONE JSON object: {"thought": "<one or two short sentences: what the page tells you and what you do next>", "actions": [ ... ]}.
23: The actions run in order. Once an action loads another page the rest of the list is dropped, because the element
24: ids change with every page: chain actions only while you stay on the page (fill fields, tick boxes, then click).
25: Elements you can act on carry an id like [12].
26: 
27: Browser actions:
28:   {"do": "login"}                                  enter this website's credentials in the login form shown and submit it
29:   {"do": "click", "id": 12}
30:   {"do": "fill", "id": 12, "text": "...", "enter": false}     type into a field; "enter": true also presses Enter
31:   {"do": "select", "id": 12, "value": "<an option's value or label>"}
32:   {"do": "set", "id": 12, "value": true}           tick/untick a checkbox, choose a radio button, or move a slider to a number
33:   {"do": "goto", "url": "<an address or path on this website that you have seen>"}
34:   {"do": "back"}    {"do": "reload"}
35:   {"do": "collect", "id": 12, "max_pages": 10}     [12] is the next-page or load-more control of a list or paged document you want in full: it is followed until the end and all pages come back as one document
36:   {"do": "fetch", "id": 12}                        download the file behind link [12] (archive, CSV, PDF, text) and read it as a document
37:   {"do": "wait"}                                   pause two seconds, for a page that is still loading
38:   {"do": "steps", "steps": [{"field": "<label>", "value": "..."}, {"press": "<button label>"}, ...]}
39:                                                    a sequence across page reloads: each step finds its control again
40:                                                    by its label on the page as it then is, so a whole chain (choose,
41:                                                    apply, choose the next, apply, fill, continue) runs in one turn.
42:                                                    "field" fills a text field, chooses in a list or ticks a box
43:                                                    (value true/false); "press" clicks a button or link. It stops at
44:                                                    the first step whose control it cannot find unambiguously and
45:                                                    tells you which steps ran. Use it for forms whose fields you know.
46:   {"do": "done", "summary": "<ten words>", "answer": "..."}   you are finished; "answer" only when you were asked for one
47: 
48: Reading the page:
49: - It is rendered as a screen reader would read it. "(described: ...)" and "(tooltip: ...)" hold text that only
50:   shows on hover, "[canvas: ...]" what a drawing says, "(in collapsed menu)" an entry of a menu that is closed
51:   (you can click it all the same), "->" where a link leads, "{data-...}" attributes of a control.
52: - A "LOCKED AREA" is disabled until you pass the check in front of it. A page can hold several checks, one per
53:   area, also inside embedded frames further down: after passing one, look for the next LOCKED AREA and its own
54:   controls. A check whose status already reads as unlocked is done; setting it again changes nothing.
55: - A "toggle" opens or closes a section. If a section you opened stays empty after you unlocked it, click its toggle
56:   twice (close, then open) to load it again.
57: - Several controls can carry the same name while only one of them does the job: tell them apart by where they
58:   lead and what their attributes say.
59: - Popups, cookie walls, access checks, error pages and expired sessions happen. Deal with them and carry on;
60:   after a session expires, log in again. Surveys, tools and help pages lead away from your task.
61: """
62: 
63: STEP_TIMEOUT = 45  # seconds for one page read or one browser action: a hung page must not freeze the whole run
64: # How many past turns stay word for word; older ones keep the reasoning and drop the page text. Each full turn resends
65: # a page of up to 14,000 characters on every call, and input tokens are most of the run's cost (the provider's prompt
66: # cache hits only now and then). FULL_TURNS=2 brings back the earlier setting for comparison.
67: FULL_TURNS = int(os.environ.get("FULL_TURNS", "1"))
68: # How many past turns are kept at all; older ones shrink to their thought. Every kept turn costs ~250 tokens on every
69: # later call, and the ERP agent runs 40-60 turns: in run 4876a0ad its calls averaged ~14k input tokens, about half of
70: # them old history (ERP was 46% of the run's input). HISTORY_TURNS=0 keeps every turn, as before.
71: HISTORY_TURNS = int(os.environ.get("HISTORY_TURNS", "10"))
72: 
73: 
74: def _thought(reply: str) -> str:
75:     """The thought of a stored reply, one line, for the condensed older history."""
76:     try:
77:         text = str(json.loads(reply).get("thought") or "")
78:     except (ValueError, AttributeError):
79:         text = reply
80:     return " ".join(text.split())[:200] or "(no thought)"
81: NAVIGATING = {"click", "goto", "back", "reload", "login", "collect", "fetch", "steps"}
82: STEPS_LIMIT, STEPS_TIMEOUT = 30, 240  # one "steps" action: at most this many steps, and seconds in all
83: ALERT = re.compile(r"\((?:alert|status)\)[^\n]*")  # a message the page announces to screen readers (Tab.observe)
84: CONTROL = re.compile(r'\[(\d+)\] (?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?(select|input(?:\(\w+\))?|button|checkbox|radio|link|clickable|switch) "([^"]*)"([^\[]*)')
85: 
86: 
87: def find_control(page: str, label: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
88:     """The id of the one control of one of `kinds` labelled `label` on the rendered page: an exact label first,
89:     then a label that contains it. (None, why) when there is none or more than one that is not disabled."""
90:     wanted = " ".join(label.casefold().split())
91:     found = [(m.group(1), m.group(2), " ".join(m.group(3).casefold().split()), m.group(4)) for m in CONTROL.finditer(page)]
92:     found = [f for f in found if f[1].split("(")[0] in kinds and "disabled" not in f[3]]
93:     for match in ([f for f in found if f[2] == wanted], [f for f in found if wanted and wanted in f[2]]):
94:         ids = list(dict.fromkeys(f[0] for f in match))
95:         if len(ids) == 1:
96:             return ids[0], match[0][1]
97:         if len(ids) > 1:
98:             return None, f'{len(ids)} controls are labelled "{label}" ({", ".join("[" + i + "]" for i in ids)}): use their ids'
99:     return None, f'no control labelled "{label}" on the page now'
100: 
101: 
102: def state_fingerprint(observation: str) -> str:
103:     """A stable signature of the model-visible page state.
104: 
105:     ``Tab.observe`` assigns fresh action ids on every read.  They are useful to
106:     the model, but must not make an unchanged page look like a successful
107:     action.  Removing only those generated ids keeps visible values, errors,
108:     dialogs and the URL in the comparison.
109:     """
110:     stable = re.sub(r"\[\d+\]", "[]", observation)
111:     return hashlib.sha1(stable.encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
112: 
113: 
114: def action_fingerprint(actions: list[dict], observation: str = "") -> str:
115:     """Use a control's visible label instead of its transient id in repeat checks."""
116:     stable_actions = []
117:     for action in actions:
118:         stable = {key: value for key, value in action.items() if key != "id"}
119:         if action.get("id") is not None:
120:             match = re.search(rf"(?m)^\[{re.escape(str(action['id']))}\](.*)$", observation)
121:             if match:
122:                 stable["target"] = match.group(1).strip()
123:         stable_actions.append(stable)
124:     return json.dumps(stable_actions, sort_keys=True)
125: 
126: ESCALATION_LIMIT = 2  # stronger turns per agent: they cost reasoning time and an image
127: 
128: 
129: class Agent:
130:     def __init__(self, name: str, tab: Tab, system: str, briefing: Callable[[], str],
131:                  extra: dict[str, Callable[[dict], Awaitable[str]]] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None,
132:                  max_steps: int = 80, think: bool = False,
133:                  idle: Callable[[str], Awaitable[str | None]] | None = None,
134:                  guard: Callable[[dict], str | None] | None = None, finish_on_repeat: int | None = None, circle_hint: str | None = None):
135:         """`briefing()` heads every turn. `extra` adds actions: name -> handler(action) -> result text.
136:         `idle("done")` lets the caller hold a finished agent until there is news for it (returns the news) or
137:         let it stop (returns None)."""
138:         self.name, self.tab, self.system, self.briefing = name, tab, system, briefing
139:         self.extra = extra or {}
140:         self.deadline = deadline or time.time() + 3600
141:         self.max_steps, self.think, self.idle = max_steps, think, idle
142:         self.guard = guard
143:         # An agent that states the same thought this many turns in a row has its answer and is only "verifying":
144:         # it gets one forced final turn instead of running out of time (stress test: the courier read the right code,
145:         # then re-verified it for 14 turns and ended with no answer).
146:         self.finish_on_repeat = finish_on_repeat
147:         self._thoughts: list[str] = []
148:         self._circle_hinted = False
149:         self._circle_hinted_at = -99
150:         self._circle_hints = 0
151:         self._escalate = False
152:         self.escalations = 0  # stronger turns given (escalation plugin), at most ESCALATION_LIMIT
153:         self._stuck = False
154:         self.circle_hint = circle_hint or (
155:             "You are going in circles: the same steps keep repeating without progress. The page may already show "
156:             "what you need, including inside embedded documents: read it fully. Otherwise open the link's address "
157:             "directly with goto, or try a different way. If you already have the answer, finish with done now.")
158:         self._circle_hint: str | None = None  # a sanity check that may veto a browser action before it runs (sanity.py)
159:         self.turns: list[dict] = []
160:         self.page_seen = ""
161:         self.held: tuple[str, str] | None = None  # a collected or fetched document, until the agent moves on
162:         self.coverage = Ledger()  # what this agent really opened, typed and followed (coverage.py)
163:         self.steps = 0
164:         self.started = time.time()
165: 
166:     @property
167:     def circle_hints(self) -> int:
168:         """How often this agent was told it is going in circles."""
169:         return self._circle_hints
170: 
171:     def document(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
172:         """What the agent is looking at: the document it collected or fetched, else the page as last read."""
173:         return self.held or (self.tab.document, self.tab.document_source)
174: 
175:     def log(self, text: str) -> None:
176:         print(f"[{self.name} {self.steps:02d} t+{time.time() - self.started:.0f}s] {text}", flush=True)
177: 
178:     def _messages(self, user: str) -> list[dict]:
179:         messages = [{"role": "system", "content": self.system}]
180:         kept = self.turns[-HISTORY_TURNS:] if HISTORY_TURNS > 0 else self.turns
181:         older = self.turns[:len(self.turns) - len(kept)]
182:         earlier = ""
183:         if older:  # one line per older turn: what the agent thought, so it still knows what it tried
184:             earlier = ("EARLIER IN THIS TASK (your thoughts, oldest first; their pages and results are no longer shown)\n"
185:                        + "\n".join(f"- {_thought(turn['assistant'])}" for turn in older) + "\n\n")
186:         for index, turn in enumerate(kept):
187:             recent = index >= len(kept) - FULL_TURNS
188:             content = turn["user"] if recent else turn["short"]
189:             messages.append({"role": "user", "content": (earlier + content) if index == 0 else content})
190:             messages.append({"role": "assistant", "content": turn["assistant"]})
191:         messages.append({"role": "user", "content": (earlier + user) if not kept else user})
192:         return messages
193: 
194:     async def _escalated_turn(self, user: str) -> dict:
195:         """One stronger turn for an agent that keeps going in circles: reasoning on, and a screenshot of the page,
196:         which shows what the text view can hide (a slider, a disabled button, a banner over the page, a scanned
197:         document). The model still decides what to do; nothing about the website is assumed here."""
198:         text = (user + "\n\nYOU ARE STUCK: your last steps keep repeating without progress. Look at the screenshot of "
199:                 "the page as it really is, think about why your steps did not work, and choose a different way. If "
200:                 "what you need is not reachable from here, finish with done.")
201:         messages = self._messages(text)

1: """The run's browsers: attach over CDP and get a page. Driving them is up to you.
2: 
3: In a run the sandbox starts the browsers (agent.json "browsers": 1 to 4, default 1) before the clock starts and sets
4: CDP_URL (browser 1) and CDP_URLS (all of them, as a JSON array). Use those: the sandbox stops browsers your agent
5: starts itself. On your own machine there is no CDP_URLS, so `connect` starts a local Chromium (once:
6: `uv run playwright install chromium`; HEADLESS=1 hides it). Docs: $API/docs/building-an-agent.md
7: """
8: import json
9: import os
10: 
11: 
12: def cdp_urls(env=os.environ) -> list[str]:
13:     """Every browser of the run, in order; [] on your own machine."""
14:     try:
15:         urls = [url for url in json.loads(env.get("CDP_URLS") or "[]") if isinstance(url, str)]
16:     except ValueError:
17:         urls = []
18:     return urls or ([env["CDP_URL"]] if env.get("CDP_URL") else [])
19: 
20: 
21: async def connect(playwright, number: int = 0):
22:     """Browser `number` of the run (0 is browser 1) and a page in it. Locally, a Chromium of its own."""
23:     urls = cdp_urls()
24:     if urls:
25:         browser = await playwright.chromium.connect_over_cdp(urls[number])
26:         context = browser.contexts[0] if browser.contexts else await browser.new_context()
27:     else:
28:         browser = await playwright.chromium.launch(headless=os.environ.get("HEADLESS") == "1")
29:         context = await browser.new_context()
30:     page = context.pages[0] if context.pages else await context.new_page()
31:     return browser, page

232:   const set = (el, value) => { el.focus(); el.value = value; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); };
233:   if (user) set(user, username);
234:   set(pass, password);
235:   pass.setAttribute('data-login-password', '1');
236:   return 'ok';
237: }
238: """

240: MAX_OBSERVATION = 14000
241: UNREADABLE = "(this document could not be read"
242: PAGE_BREAK = "===== collected page"  # between the pages of a list or document that `collect` followed to its end

245: class _Text(HTMLParser):
246:     def __init__(self):
247:         super().__init__()
248:         self.parts, self.skip = [], 0
249: 
250:     def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
251:         if tag in ("script", "style"):
252:             self.skip += 1
253:         elif tag in ("p", "div", "tr", "br", "li", "h1", "h2", "h3", "table"):
254:             self.parts.append("\n")
255:         elif tag in ("td", "th"):
256:             self.parts.append(" | ")
257: 
258:     def handle_endtag(self, tag):
259:         if tag in ("script", "style") and self.skip:
260:             self.skip -= 1
261: 
262:     def handle_data(self, data):
263:         if not self.skip:
264:             self.parts.append(data)

267: def clean_text(text: str) -> str:
268:     text = re.sub(r"[​-‏⁠-⁤﻿­͏؜᠎]", "", text)
269:     return re.sub(r"\n\s*\n+", "\n", re.sub(r"[  ]+", " ", text)).strip()
270: 
271: 
272: def without_ids(text: str) -> str:
273:     """A document for reading only: the element ids of the pages it came from are gone by now."""
274:     return re.sub(r"\[\d+\] (?=(?:\(in collapsed menu\) )?[a-z-]+(?:\([a-z]+\))? \")", "", text)
275: 
276: 
277: def _xml_local(tag: str) -> str:
278:     return tag.rsplit("}", 1)[-1]
279: 
280: 
281: def _xlsx_text(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> str:
282:     """Every sheet of a workbook, one line per row, cells separated by " | " (text cells resolved from the
283:     shared-strings table, where Excel keeps them apart from the rows)."""
284:     import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
285:     names = set(archive.namelist())
286:     shared: list[str] = []
287:     if "xl/sharedStrings.xml" in names:
288:         for item in ET.fromstring(archive.read("xl/sharedStrings.xml")):
289:             shared.append("".join(node.text or "" for node in item.iter() if _xml_local(node.tag) == "t"))
290:     sheets = sorted((n for n in names if n.startswith("xl/worksheets/") and n.endswith(".xml")),
291:                     key=lambda n: int(re.sub(r"\D", "", n) or 0))
292:     parts = []
293:     for sheet in sheets:
294:         rows = []
295:         for row in ET.fromstring(archive.read(sheet)).iter():
296:             if _xml_local(row.tag) != "row":
297:                 continue
298:             cells = []
299:             for cell in row:
300:                 if _xml_local(cell.tag) != "c":
301:                     continue
302:                 value = next((n.text or "" for n in cell.iter() if _xml_local(n.tag) == "v"), None)
303:                 if cell.get("t") == "s" and value is not None and value.isdigit() and int(value) < len(shared):
304:                     value = shared[int(value)]
305:                 elif cell.get("t") == "inlineStr":
306:                     value = "".join(n.text or "" for n in cell.iter() if _xml_local(n.tag) == "t")
307:                 cells.append(value or "")
308:             if any(cells):
309:                 rows.append(" | ".join(cells))
310:         parts.append(f"=== SHEET {sheet.rsplit('/', 1)[-1]} ===\n" + "\n".join(rows))
311:     return "\n".join(parts)
312: 
313: 
314: def _docx_text(archive: zipfile.ZipFile) -> str:
315:     """A Word document's paragraphs, one per line; a table row's cells on one line separated by " | "."""
316:     import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
317:     body = ET.fromstring(archive.read("word/document.xml"))
318: 
319:     def text_of(node) -> str:
320:         return "".join(n.text or "" for n in node.iter() if _xml_local(n.tag) == "t")
321: 
322:     lines = []
323:     for node in body.iter():
324:         tag = _xml_local(node.tag)
325:         if tag == "tr":
326:             lines.append(" | ".join(text_of(cell) for cell in node if _xml_local(cell.tag) == "tc"))
327:         elif tag == "p" and not any(_xml_local(parent.tag) == "tc" for parent in _ancestors(body, node)):
328:             lines.append(text_of(node))
329:     return "\n".join(line for line in lines if line.strip())
330: 
331: 
332: def _ancestors(root, target) -> list:
333:     parents = {child: parent for parent in root.iter() for child in parent}
334:     found, node = [], target
335:     while node in parents:
336:         node = parents[node]
337:         found.append(node)
338:     return found
339: 
340: 
341: def _decode(data: bytes) -> str:
342:     """UTF-8, else Windows-1252 (what German Excel and many older systems write), so umlauts survive."""
343:     try:
344:         return data.decode("utf-8")
345:     except UnicodeDecodeError:
346:         return data.decode("cp1252", errors="replace")
347: 
348: 
349: def document_text(data: bytes, content_type: str, name: str, depth: int = 0) -> str:
350:     """The text of a fetched file: archives are opened, Word and Excel files are read as text and table rows, markup
351:     is stripped, PDFs are read when pypdf is installed."""
352:     kind = (content_type or "").lower()
353:     lower = name.lower()
354:     if data[:4] == b"PK\x03\x04" or "zip" in kind or lower.endswith(".zip"):
355:         try:
356:             archive = zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(data))
357:         except zipfile.BadZipFile:
358:             return "(unreadable archive)"
359:         names = set(archive.namelist())
360:         try:
361:             if "xl/workbook.xml" in names:
362:                 return clean_text(f"SPREADSHEET {name}\n" + _xlsx_text(archive))
363:             if "word/document.xml" in names:
364:                 return clean_text(f"DOCUMENT {name}\n" + _docx_text(archive))
365:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  (a damaged Office file: fall back to reading it as an archive)
366:             pass
367:         parts = [f"ARCHIVE {name} with files: " + ", ".join(info.filename for info in archive.infolist())]
368:         for info in archive.infolist()[:40]:
369:             if info.is_dir() or depth > 4:
370:                 continue
371:             parts.append(f"=== FILE {info.filename} ===\n" + document_text(archive.read(info), "", info.filename, depth + 1))
372:         return "\n".join(parts)
373:     if data[:5] == b"%PDF-" or "pdf" in kind:
374:         try:
375:             from pypdf import PdfReader
376:             return clean_text("\n".join(page.extract_text() or "" for page in PdfReader(io.BytesIO(data)).pages))
377:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
378:             return f"(PDF could not be read: {error})"
379:     text = _decode(data)
380:     if "html" in kind or "xml" in kind or re.search(r"<(html|body|table|div|p|w:document|worksheet)\b", text[:4000], re.I):
381:         parser = _Text()
382:         parser.feed(text)
383:         text = "".join(parser.parts)
384:     return clean_text(text)

387: class Tab:
388:     """One browser tab on one website, driven by one agent."""
389: 
390:     def __init__(self, page, site: dict):
391:         self.page = page
392:         self.site_id = site.get("siteId", "")
393:         self.base_url = site["url"].rstrip("/")
394:         self.credentials = site.get("credentials") or {}
395:         self.frames: list[tuple[int, int, object]] = []  # id range -> frame
396:         self.document = ""  # what `keep` files: the page as last read, a collected listing or a fetched file
397:         self.document_source = ""
398:         self.last_collect: dict | None = None  # how the last `collect` ended: where, control, pages, capped
399:         self.events: list[str] = []
400:         self.bad_status = 0
401:         self.loading: set = set()  # page, frame and data requests that have not come back yet
402:         self.spares: list = []  # browser contexts of the run's other browsers, for a renewal elsewhere (see renew)
403:         self.renewals = 0
404:         self._watch(page)
405: 
406:     def _watch(self, page) -> None:
407:         page.on("dialog", lambda dialog: asyncio.ensure_future(self._on_dialog(dialog)))
408:         page.on("response", self._on_response)
409:         page.on("request", lambda request: self.loading.add(request) if request.resource_type in ("document", "xhr", "fetch") else None)
410:         page.on("requestfinished", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))
411:         page.on("requestfailed", lambda request: self.loading.discard(request))
412: 
413:     async def renew(self) -> str:
414:         """Swap a broken tab for a fresh one in the same browser: same session and cookies, a clean page. A tab can get
415:         stuck ("frame was detached", loads that never finish) while the website itself is fine: in sandbox runs the
416:         investigators' tab kept timing out for minutes while a fresh tab on the same site loaded at once.
417:         From the second renewal on, the fresh tab opens in another of the run's browsers and logs in again: in sandbox
418:         runs 41a5de64, c3c4b1e8 and 64397a5e one browser could not load the tender portal for the whole run, fresh
419:         tabs in it included, while the other browsers kept working."""
420:         old = self.page
421:         self.renewals += 1
422:         moved = self.renewals >= 2 and bool(self.spares)
423:         context = self.spares[(self.renewals - 2) % len(self.spares)] if moved else old.context
424:         page = await context.new_page()
425:         self.page, self.frames, self.loading, self.bad_status = page, [], set(), 0
426:         self._watch(page)
427:         try:
428:             await old.close()
429:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
430:             pass
431:         result = await self.goto(self.base_url + "/")
432:         if not moved:
433:             return result
434:         try:
435:             result += "; " + await self.login()
436:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
437:             result += f"; logging in again failed: {str(error)[:120]}"
438:         return "moved to another browser (this one could not load the website): " + result
439: 
440:     async def screenshot(self) -> str | None:
441:         """The visible part of the page as a base64 JPEG, for a model that reads images; None when it fails."""
442:         try:
443:             import base64
444:             image = await asyncio.wait_for(self.page.screenshot(type="jpeg", quality=55, full_page=False), 15)
445:             return base64.b64encode(image).decode("ascii")
446:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
447:             return None

449:     async def _on_dialog(self, dialog):
450:         self.events.append(f'the browser asked "{dialog.message}" ({dialog.type}); it was accepted')
451:         try:
452:             await dialog.accept()
453:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
454:             pass

456:     def _on_response(self, response):
457:         try:
458:             if response.request.is_navigation_request() and response.frame == self.page.main_frame:
459:                 self.bad_status = response.status if response.status >= 500 else 0

463:     async def settle(self):
464:         """Wait until the page, its frames and the data they fetch have arrived and nothing more is on its way."""
465:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
466:         end, quiet = loop.time() + 12, None
467:         await asyncio.sleep(0.1)  # let a click start its request
468:         while loop.time() < end:
469:             if self.loading:
470:                 quiet = None
471:             elif quiet is None:
472:                 quiet = loop.time()
473:             elif loop.time() - quiet >= 0.2:
474:                 break
475:             await asyncio.sleep(0.04)
476:         else:
477:             self.loading.clear()  # a request that never ends must not hold up every later step
478:         for frame in list(self.page.frames):
479:             try:
480:                 await frame.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=8000 if frame == self.page.main_frame else 3000)
481:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
482:                 pass
483:         for _ in range(3):  # a server error page: retry the same address, as a person would press reload
484:             if not self.bad_status:
485:                 break
486:             self.events.append(f"the server answered HTTP {self.bad_status}; reloaded")
487:             await asyncio.sleep(0.4)
488:             try:
489:                 await self.page.reload(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
490:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
491:                 break

493:     async def _frame_text(self, frame, start: int, depth: int) -> tuple[str, int]:
494:         try:
495:             prepared = await frame.evaluate(PREPARE_JS)
496:             if prepared["opened"]:
497:                 await self.settle()  # lazy content of the sections just opened
498:             for name in prepared["closed"]:
499:                 self.events.append(f'closed the popup "{name}"')
500:             shot = await frame.evaluate(SNAPSHOT_JS, start)
501:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
502:             return f"{UNREADABLE}: {str(error)[:120]})", start
503:         self.frames.append((start, shot["next"], frame))
504:         text, following = shot["text"], shot["next"]
505:         for marker in re.findall(r"⟦FRAME:(\d+)⟧", text):
506:             inner = "(embedded document not loaded)"
507:             if depth < 4:
508:                 try:
509:                     handle = await frame.query_selector(f'[data-aid="{marker}"]')
510:                     child = await handle.content_frame() if handle else None
511:                     if child:
512:                         try:
513:                             await child.wait_for_load_state("domcontentloaded", timeout=4000)
514:                         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
515:                             pass
516:                         inner, following = await self._frame_text(child, following, depth + 1)
517:                 except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
518:                     inner = f"(embedded document could not be read: {str(error)[:120]})"
519:             block = "┌── embedded document: " if inner.strip() else "┌── embedded document (empty): "
520:             text = text.replace(f"⟦FRAME:{marker}⟧", block, 1).replace(
521:                 block, block, 1)
522:             # the marker line carries the frame's title; append the frame's content under it
523:             lines = text.split("\n")
524:             for index, line in enumerate(lines):
525:                 if line.startswith(block) and not line.endswith("⁣"):
526:                     lines[index] = line + "⁣"
527:                     lines.insert(index + 1, "\n".join("│ " + row for row in inner.split("\n")) + "\n└── end of embedded document")
528:                     break
529:             text = "\n".join(lines)
530:         return text.replace("⁣", ""), following

532:     async def read(self) -> str:
533:         """The current page as text, with fresh element ids."""
534:         for _ in range(4):  # a page that navigates while it is read is read again
535:             await self.settle()
536:             self.frames = []
537:             text, _ = await self._frame_text(self.page.main_frame, 1, 0)
538:             if not text.startswith(UNREADABLE):
539:                 break
540:         try:
541:             title = await self.page.title()
542:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
543:             title = ""
544:         self.document = f"url: {self.page.url}\ntitle: {clean_text(title)}\n{clean_text(text)}"
545:         self.document_source = self.page.url
546:         return self.document

552:         return text

558:     async def _modal_is_open(self) -> bool:
559:         """Whether a page-level dialog now prevents ordinary controls from being used."""
560:         script = """() => {
561:           const visible = el => { const s = getComputedStyle(el); return !el.hidden && el.getAttribute('aria-hidden') !== 'true' && s.display !== 'none' && s.visibility !== 'hidden'; };
562:           return [...document.querySelectorAll('dialog[open],[aria-modal="true"]')]
563:             .some(el => visible(el) && (el.tagName !== 'DIALOG' || el.matches(':modal')));
564:         }"""
565:         for frame in self.page.frames:
566:             try:
567:                 if await frame.evaluate(script):
568:                     return True
569:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
570:                 continue
571:         return False

574:         try:
575:             number = int(aid)

589:         return await locator.evaluate(
590:             """el => ({tag: el.tagName, type: (el.getAttribute('type') || '').toLowerCase(), href: el.href || '',

592:                       name: (el.innerText || el.value || el.getAttribute('aria-label') || '').replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim().slice(0, 400)})""")

594:     async def click(self, aid) -> str:
595:         locator = self._locator(aid)
596:         if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
597:             return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more; read the current page"
598:         info = await self._describe(locator)
599:         if info["disabled"]:
600:             return f"[{aid}] is disabled (inside a locked or inert area?); nothing happened"
601:         before = self.page.url
602:         try:
603:             await locator.click(timeout=2500)
604:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  hidden in a collapsed menu, or covered: activate it directly
605:             try:
606:                 await locator.evaluate("el => el.click()")
607:             except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
608:                 return f"could not click [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
609:         await self.settle()
610:         if await self._modal_is_open():
611:             return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
612:         moved = self.page.url != before
613:         return f'clicked [{aid}] "{info["name"]}"' + (f"; now at {self.page.url}" if moved else "")

615:     async def fill(self, aid, text: str, enter: bool = False) -> str:
616:         locator = self._locator(aid)
617:         if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
618:             return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
619:         try:
620:             await locator.fill(str(text), timeout=2500)
621:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
622:             return f"could not fill [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
623:         readback = await self._readback(locator, str(text))  # before Enter can load another page
624:         if enter:
625:             await locator.press("Enter")
626:             await self.settle()
627:         if await self._modal_is_open():
628:             return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
629:         return f"filled [{aid}]" + (" and pressed Enter" if enter else "") + readback

631:     async def _readback(self, locator, typed: str) -> str:
632:         """What a field holds right after typing, when that is not what was typed: a form can reformat, cut or
633:         silently refuse a value, and a fill that "worked" proves nothing about what the portal will save."""
634:         try:
635:             kind, value = await locator.evaluate(
636:                 """el => [(el.getAttribute('type') || '').toLowerCase(),
637:                           'value' in el ? String(el.value) : (el.isContentEditable ? el.innerText : null)]""")
638:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
639:             return ""
640:         if kind == "password" or value is None:
641:             return ""
642:         shown, wanted = clean_text(value), clean_text(typed)
643:         if shown == wanted:
644:             return ""
645:         if same_value(wanted, shown):
646:             return f'; the field shows it as "{shown[:80]}"'
647:         return (f'; {NOT_KEPT} "{shown[:80]}", not what was typed: it changed or refused the value. '
648:                 "Read the field's hint and correct it before you move on")

650:     async def select(self, aid, value: str) -> str:
651:         locator = self._locator(aid)
652:         if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
653:             return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
654:         wanted = str(value)
655:         for attempt in ({"value": wanted}, {"label": wanted}):
656:             try:
657:                 await locator.select_option(timeout=2000, **attempt)
658:                 await self.settle()
659:                 if await self._modal_is_open():
660:                     return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
661:                 return f'selected "{wanted}" in [{aid}]'
662:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
663:                 continue
664:         options = await locator.evaluate("el => [...(el.options || [])].map(o => o.value + '=' + o.textContent.trim())")
665:         loose = [o.split("=", 1)[0] for o in options if wanted.lower() in o.lower()]
666:         if len(loose) == 1:
667:             await locator.select_option(value=loose[0])
668:             await self.settle()
669:             return f'selected "{loose[0]}" in [{aid}]'
670:         return f'[{aid}] has no option "{wanted}"; options: {"; ".join(options)[:600]}'

672:     async def set(self, aid, value) -> str:
673:         locator = self._locator(aid)
674:         if locator is None or await locator.count() == 0:
675:             return f"there is no element [{aid}] on the page any more"
676:         info = await self._describe(locator)
677:         if info["disabled"]:
678:             return f"[{aid}] is disabled; nothing happened"
679:         try:
680:             if info["type"] in ("checkbox", "radio"):
681:                 wanted = bool(value)
682:                 try:
683:                     await locator.set_checked(wanted, timeout=1500)
684:                 except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  covered or restyled: toggle it as its label would
685:                     if await locator.is_checked() != wanted:
686:                         await locator.evaluate("el => el.click()")
687:                 if await locator.is_checked() != wanted:
688:                     return f"[{aid}] did not change; it is still {'unchecked' if wanted else 'checked'}"
689:             else:  # a slider or another input whose value is set in one go
690:                 await locator.evaluate(
691:                     """(el, v) => { const proto = Object.getPrototypeOf(el); const d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(proto, 'value');
692:                                    d && d.set ? d.set.call(el, String(v)) : el.value = String(v);
693:                                    el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }""",
694:                     value)
695:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
696:             return f"could not set [{aid}]: {str(error)[:150]}"
697:         await self.settle()
698:         if await self._modal_is_open():
699:             return "the page now has a modal dialog; read it before acting behind it"
700:         return f"set [{aid}] to {value}"

702:     def _on_site(self, url: str) -> bool:
703:         return urlparse(url).netloc == urlparse(self.base_url).netloc
704: 
705:     async def goto(self, url: str) -> str:

244:     for row in rows:
245:         if not isinstance(row, dict):
246:             rejected += 1
247:             continue
248:         # Condition rows identify themselves by their scale list; every other
249:         # record has stable source identifiers that the merge layer relies on.
250:         identified = isinstance(row.get("scales"), list) if kind == "price_conditions" \
251:             else all(_text(row.get(name)) for name in identifiers)
252:         if identified:
253:             valid.append(row)
254:         else:
255:             rejected += 1
256:     if kind == "requirements" and valid and not _text(data.get("revision")):
257:         return None, "schema validation rejected requirements without a revision identifier"
258:     if kind == "price_conditions" and valid and not _text(data.get("material_number")):
259:         return None, "schema validation rejected price conditions without a material number"
260:     clean = dict(data)
261:     clean[root] = valid
262:     note = "" if not rejected else f"schema validation dropped {rejected} malformed {root} record(s)"
263:     return clean, note

266: QUIET_FIELDS = ("description", "unit", "number_format", "note")  # wording, not a fact the calculator uses
267: 
268: 
269: def _merge(store: dict, key, record: dict) -> list[tuple[str, object, object]]:
270:     """The value filed last is the one in use. Returns where it replaced a different one, as (field, earlier,
271:     later): two documents that disagree about the same record are a conflict to report, not to overwrite in
272:     silence (a draft, a superseded revision and a look-alike record all look like this)."""
273:     old = store.setdefault(key, {})
274:     replaced = []
275:     for name, value in record.items():
276:         if value is not None and value != "" and value != []:
277:             earlier = old.get(name)
278:             if earlier is not None and name not in QUIET_FIELDS and not same_value(earlier, value):
279:                 replaced.append((name, earlier, value))
280:             old[name] = value
281:     return replaced

284: class CaseFile:
285:     def __init__(self, brief: str, context: dict):
286:         self.brief = brief
287:         self.reference = _text(context.get("tender_reference")) or ""
288:         self.scenario = parse_when(context.get("scenario_date")) or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
289:         self.company = _text(context.get("company_name")) or ""
290:         self.vat_id = _text(context.get("vat_id")) or ""
291:         senders = context.get("authorized_senders") or {}
292:         self.senders = {topic: (_text(senders.get(topic)) or "").split("@")[0].lower() for topic in TOPICS}
293:         self.mailbox: str | None = None
294:         self.positions: dict[str, dict] = {}
295:         self.clarifications: dict[str, dict] = {}
296:         self.revisions: dict[str, dict] = {}
297:         self.requirements: dict[tuple[str, str], dict] = {}
298:         self.materials: dict[str, dict] = {}
299:         self.conditions: dict[str, dict[tuple, dict]] = {}
300:         self.messages: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
301:         self.evidence: list[dict] = []  # extracted records, retained with the page and agent that supplied them
302:         self.conflicts: list[str] = []  # where a later document replaced a different value of an earlier one
303:         self.answers: dict[str, tuple[str, str]] = {}  # question id -> (complete | absent, note)
304:         self.filed: set[str] = set()
305:         self.news: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
306:         self.pending = 0
307:         self.pending_by_agent: dict[str, int] = {}
308:         self.version = 0
309:         self._changed = asyncio.Event()

311:     # ---- filing evidence -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
312: 
313:     def pending_for(self, agent: str | None = None) -> int:
314:         if agent is None:
315:             return self.pending
316:         return self.pending_by_agent.get(agent, 0)
317: 
318:     def _bump(self) -> None:
319:         self.version += 1
320:         self._changed.set()
321: 
322:     async def wait_change(self, seen: int, timeout: float) -> bool:
323:         """True once the case file has moved past version `seen`."""
324:         loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
325:         end = loop.time() + timeout
326:         while self.version == seen:
327:             self._changed.clear()
328:             left = end - loop.time()
329:             if left <= 0:
330:                 return False
331:             try:
332:                 await asyncio.wait_for(self._changed.wait(), timeout=left)
333:             except asyncio.TimeoutError:
334:                 return False
335:         return True

337:     def take_news(self, agent: str) -> list[str]:
338:         return self.news.pop(agent, [])
339: 
340:     def file(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str) -> str:
341:         """File a document an agent chose; the extraction runs in the background and reports back as news."""
342:         if kind not in SHAPES:
343:             return f'unknown kind "{kind}"; the kinds are: {", ".join(SHAPES)}'
344:         if len(text.strip()) < 20:
345:             return "there is no document to file"
346:         # The pages of a collected list are read side by side: shorter replies, sooner.
347:         raw_pages = [page for page in re.split(re.escape(PAGE_BREAK) + r" \d+ =====\n", text) if len(page.strip()) >= 20]
348:         pages = _dedup_collected_pages(raw_pages)
349:         folder = os.environ.get("AGENT_DOCS_DIR")
350:         if folder:
351:             os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
352:         fresh = 0
353:         for page in pages:
354:             digest = hashlib.sha1((kind + "\n" + page).encode("utf-8", "replace")).hexdigest()
355:             if digest in self.filed:
356:                 continue
357:             self.filed.add(digest)
358:             self.pending += 1
359:             self.pending_by_agent[agent] = self.pending_by_agent.get(agent, 0) + 1
360:             fresh += 1
361:             if folder:  # local tuning only: preserve the exact evidence that was filed, one page per file
362:                 filename = f"{len(self.filed):03d}-{kind}-{digest[:8]}.json"
363:                 with open(os.path.join(folder, filename), "w", encoding="utf-8") as out:
364:                     json.dump({"kind": kind, "source": source, "agent": agent, "text": page}, out,
365:                               ensure_ascii=False)
366:             asyncio.ensure_future(self._extract(kind, page, source, agent, digest))
367:         if not fresh:
368:             return f"this document is already filed as {kind}"
369:         return (f"filed {len(text)} characters ({fresh} page(s)) from {source} as {kind}; the facts in it will be "
370:                 "reported to you")
371: 
372:     async def _extract(self, kind: str, text: str, source: str, agent: str, digest: str = "") -> None:
373:         try:
374:             # The extraction schema contains the exact facts needed downstream. Repeating the full rules brief
375:             # for every page made these independent extraction calls unnecessarily large and slow.
376:             prompt = (f"The tender reference is {self.reference}; the scenario date is "
377:                       f"{self.scenario.isoformat()}.\n\nKIND OF RECORD: {kind}\nSHAPE\n{SHAPES[kind]}\n\n"
378:                       f"EVIDENCE (from {source})\n{text[:60000]}")
379:             raw = await llm.chat_json([{"role": "system", "content": EXTRACT_SYSTEM}, {"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
380:                                       # This is schema-constrained transcription, not a navigation decision. The
381:                                       # sandbox model's thinking mode repeatedly consumed its 150 s timeout here.
382:                                       think=False, max_tokens=12000, label=f"extract:{kind}",
383:                                       provider=os.environ.get("EXTRACT_PROVIDER", "qwen"))
384:             data, validation = validate_extraction(kind, raw)
385:             if data and sanity.enabled("grounding"):
386:                 data, dropped = sanity.ground(data, text)
387:                 if dropped:
388:                     note = "not found on the page, so left out: " + ", ".join(dropped[:12])
389:                     validation = f"{validation}; {note}" if validation else note
390:                     print(f"[grounding {kind}] {note}"[:1500], flush=True)
391:             stock_note = _strip_physical_only_stock(text, data) if kind == "material" else ""
392:             if stock_note:
393:                 validation = f"{validation}; {stock_note}" if validation else stock_note
394:             summary = self.merge(kind, data) if data else (validation or "the extraction failed; file the document again")
395:             if data and summary == "nothing usable was found in it":
396:                 data = None
397:                 summary = (f"{stock_note}; no usable records were extracted" if stock_note
398:                            else "no usable records were extracted; check the evidence and file it again")
399:             elif validation and data:
400:                 summary = validation + "; " + summary
401:             if data:
402:                 self.evidence.append({"id": digest, "kind": kind, "source": source, "agent": agent,
403:                                       "summary": summary, "validation": validation, "extracted": data})
404:             print(f"[extract {kind}] {source} -> {json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)[:1800]}", flush=True)
405:         except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
406:             data = None
407:             summary = f"the extraction failed ({str(error)[:120]}); file the document again"
408:         if not data:
409:             self.filed.discard(digest)  # so that filing it again is accepted rather than refused as a duplicate
410:         self.news.setdefault(agent, []).append(f"From the {kind} document you filed ({source}): {summary}")
411:         self.pending = max(0, self.pending - 1)
412:         left = self.pending_by_agent.get(agent, 0) - 1
413:         if left > 0:
414:             self.pending_by_agent[agent] = left
415:         else:
416:             self.pending_by_agent.pop(agent, None)
417:         self._bump()

419:     def merge(self, kind: str, data: dict) -> str:
420:         """Merge extracted records; returns a one-line account of what they said."""
421:         told: list[str] = []
422:         clashes: list[str] = []
423: 
424:         def put(store: dict, key, row: dict, label: str) -> None:
425:             for name, earlier, later in _merge(store, key, row):
426:                 clashes.append(f"{label} {name}: {earlier!r} on an earlier document, {later!r} on this one")
427: 
428:         if kind == "positions":
429:             for row in data.get("positions") or []:
430:                 key = _text(row.get("position"))
431:                 if key:
432:                     put(self.positions, key, row, f"position {key}")
433:                     told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('quantity')} {row.get('unit') or ''} -> {row.get('requirement_ref')}")
434:         elif kind == "clarifications":
435:             for row in data.get("answers") or []:
436:                 key = _text(row.get("number"))
437:                 if key:
438:                     self.clarifications[key] = row
439:                     told.append(f"answer {key} ({row.get('timestamp')})")
440:         elif kind == "revisions":
441:             for row in data.get("revisions") or []:
442:                 key = _text(row.get("revision"))
443:                 if key:
444:                     put(self.revisions, key, row, f"revision {key}")
445:                     told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('status')} ({row.get('date')})")
446:         elif kind == "requirements":
447:             revision = _text(data.get("revision")) or ""
448:             for row in data.get("requirements") or []:
449:                 key = _text(row.get("requirement_ref"))
450:                 if key:
451:                     put(self.requirements, (revision, key), row, f"requirement {key} in revision {revision or '?'}")
452:                     told.append(f"{key} in revision {revision or '?'}: bore {row.get('bore_mm')}, stroke {row.get('stroke_mm')}"
453:                                 f"{' (usable travel)' if row.get('stroke_is_usable_travel') else ''}, {row.get('pressure_bar')} bar, "
454:                                 f"{row.get('mounting')}, certification {row.get('certification')}, group {row.get('catalogue_group')}")
455:         elif kind == "material":
456:             for row in data.get("materials") or []:
457:                 key = _text(row.get("material_number"))
458:                 if key:
459:                     put(self.materials, key, row, f"material {key}")
460:                     told.append(f"{key}: " + ", ".join(f"{name}={value}" for name, value in row.items()
461:                                                        if value is not None and name not in ("material_number", "description", "number_format")))
462:         elif kind == "price_conditions":
463:             key = _text(data.get("material_number"))
464:             for row in data.get("conditions") or []:
465:                 if key and row.get("scales"):
466:                     self.conditions.setdefault(key, {})[(str(row.get("valid_from")), str(row.get("valid_to")))] = row
467:                     told.append(f"{key}: {row.get('valid_from')}..{row.get('valid_to')} {row.get('currency')} "
468:                                 f"per {row.get('price_unit_pieces')} pcs, {len(row['scales'])} scales")
469:         elif kind == "mail":
470:             if _text(data.get("mailbox_address")) and "@" in data["mailbox_address"]:
471:                 self.mailbox = data["mailbox_address"].strip()
472:             for row in data.get("messages") or []:
473:                 key = (str(row.get("sender")), str(row.get("timestamp")), str(row.get("subject")))
474:                 self.messages[key] = row
475:                 blocks = [topic for topic in ("discount",) + TOPICS if row.get(topic)]
476:                 told.append(f"{row.get('subject')} from {row.get('sender')} at {row.get('timestamp')} about "
477:                             f"{row.get('tender_reference')}: {row.get('topic')} ({', '.join(blocks) or 'no usable data'})")
478:         self._bump()
479:         account = "; ".join(told)[:1500] if told else "nothing usable was found in it"
480:         if clashes:
481:             self.conflicts.extend(clashes)
482:             print(f"[conflict {kind}] " + " | ".join(clashes)[:1200], flush=True)
483:             account = ("CONFLICT WITH AN EARLIER DOCUMENT (the value filed last is now in use): " + "; ".join(clashes[:6])
484:                        + ". Two records disagree: check the status, date and reference of both against the brief's "
485:                          "rules before you rely on either. " + account)
486:         return account

490:     def governing_revision(self) -> str | None:
491:         """The latest current revision; one with requirements on file first, so that a document listed as "current"
492:         next to the specification (eval variant B: a change notice) cannot replace the specification itself."""
493:         current = []
494:         with_requirements = {same for (revision, _ref) in self.requirements for same in [revision] if revision}
495:         for key, row in self.revisions.items():
496:             when = parse_when(row.get("date"))
497:             if row.get("status") == "current" and (when is None or when <= self.scenario):
498:                 filed = any(same_text(key, revision) for revision in with_requirements)
499:                 current.append((filed, when or datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc), key))
500:         return max(current)[2] if current else None
501: 
502:     def _authorized(self, row: dict, topic: str) -> bool:
503:         """The brief's test for a record: exact tender reference, authorized sender, not after the scenario date."""
504:         sender = (_text(row.get("sender")) or "").lower()
505:         local, _, domain = sender.partition("@")
506:         if self.senders.get(topic) and local != self.senders[topic]:
507:             return False
508:         if self.mailbox and domain and domain != self.mailbox.lower().partition("@")[2]:
509:             return False
510:         if (_text(row.get("tender_reference")) or "").upper() != self.reference.upper():
511:             return False
512:         when = parse_when(row.get("timestamp"))
513:         return when is None or when <= self.scenario
514: 
515:     def authorities(self) -> Authorities:
516:         result = Authorities()
517:         floor = datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
518:         ordered = sorted(self.messages.values(), key=lambda row: parse_when(row.get("timestamp")) or floor)
519:         day = self.scenario.date()
520:         for row in ordered:  # oldest first: a newer record replaces the older one, key by key
521:             fmt = row.get("number_format")
522:             discount = row.get("discount") or {}
523:             if discount.get("approves") and self._authorized(row, "discount_approval"):
524:                 percent = parse_number(discount.get("percent"), fmt)
525:                 if percent is not None:
526:                     result.discount_percent = percent
527:                     result.discount_min_order = parse_number(discount.get("min_order_value"), fmt)
528:             if row.get("condition_rules") and self._authorized(row, "condition_rules"):
529:                 for rule in row["condition_rules"]:
530:                     if _text(rule.get("group")) and rule.get("discount_applies_to") in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge", "none"):
531:                         result.clauses[rule["group"].strip()] = rule["discount_applies_to"]
532:             if row.get("price_indices") and self._authorized(row, "price_indices"):
533:                 by_code: dict[str, list[dict]] = {}
534:                 for entry in row["price_indices"]:
535:                     if _text(entry.get("code")):
536:                         by_code.setdefault(entry["code"].strip(), []).append(entry)
537:                 for code, entries in by_code.items():
538:                     result.index_rates.pop(code, None)  # the latest message decides this code alone
539:                     for entry in entries:
540:                         start, end = parse_when(entry.get("valid_from")), parse_when(entry.get("valid_to"), end_of_day=True)
541:                         if (start and start.date() > day) or (end and end.date() < day):
542:                             continue
543:                         rate = parse_number(entry.get("rate"), fmt)
544:                         unit = re.search(r"/\s*(mg|g|kg|t)\b", str(entry.get("unit") or "EUR/kg"))
545:                         if rate is not None:
546:                             result.index_rates[code] = rate / MASS_TO_GRAMS[unit.group(1) if unit else "kg"]
547:                             break
548:             if row.get("tech_release") and self._authorized(row, "tech_release"):
549:                 for entry in row["tech_release"]:
550:                     reserve = _int(entry.get("reserve_mm_per_end"))
551:                     if reserve is not None:
552:                         key = _text(entry.get("reserve_key")) or f"revision {entry.get('revision')}"
553:                         result.reserves[key] = (_text(entry.get("revision")), reserve)
554:             if row.get("packaging_tariffs") and self._authorized(row, "packaging_tariffs"):
555:                 for entry in row["packaging_tariffs"]:
556:                     rate = parse_number(entry.get("eur_per_carton"), fmt)
557:                     if _text(entry.get("key")) and rate is not None:
558:                         result.tariffs[entry["key"].strip()] = rate
559:             if row.get("delivery_release") and self._authorized(row, "delivery_release"):
560:                 for entry in row["delivery_release"]:
561:                     weeks = _int(entry.get("weeks"))
562:                     if _text(entry.get("key")) and weeks is not None:
563:                         result.commitments[entry["key"].strip()] = Commitment(
564:                             _text(entry.get("material_number")) or "", weeks, _int(entry.get("max_quantity")))
565:             if row.get("fx_fixing") and self._authorized(row, "fx_fixing"):
566:                 for entry in row["fx_fixing"]:
567:                     rate = parse_number(entry.get("eur_per_unit"), fmt)
568:                     if _text(entry.get("key")) and rate is not None:
569:                         result.fx[entry["key"].strip()] = rate
570:             if row.get("setup_pools") and self._authorized(row, "setup_pools"):
571:                 for entry in row["setup_pools"]:
572:                     fee = parse_number(entry.get("fee"), fmt)
573:                     if _text(entry.get("key")) and fee is not None:
574:                         result.pools[entry["key"].strip()] = (fee, entry.get("cent_allocation") or "largest_remainder")
575:             if row.get("project_bonus") and self._authorized(row, "project_bonus"):
576:                 for entry in row["project_bonus"]:
577:                     bands = []
578:                     for band in entry.get("bands") or []:
579:                         lower, percent = parse_number(band.get("from"), fmt), parse_number(band.get("percent"), fmt)
580:                         if percent is not None:
581:                             bands.append(BonusBand(lower or Decimal(0), parse_number(band.get("to"), fmt), percent))
582:                     if _text(entry.get("key")) and bands:
583:                         result.bonus[entry["key"].strip()] = bands
584:         return result
