586:     def inputs(self) -> SimpleNamespace:
587:         governing = self.governing_revision()
588:         positions = [Position(key, _text(row.get("requirement_ref")) or "", _int(row.get("quantity")) or 0,
589:                               bool(_resolve_is_set(row.get("unit"), row.get("unit_is_set"))),
590:                               _text(row.get("description")) or "")
591:                      for key, row in sorted(self.positions.items())]
592:         clarifications = []
593:         for key, row in self.clarifications.items():
594:             entry = Clarification(key, parse_when(row.get("timestamp")),
595:                                   withdraws=[str(n).strip() for n in row.get("withdraws") or [] if _text(n)])
596:             for change in row.get("quantity_changes") or []:
597:                 quantity = _int(change.get("quantity"))
598:                 if _text(change.get("position")) and quantity is not None:
599:                     # The explicit unit is the source of truth. A model's boolean without a copied unit can
600:                     # contradict the tender's unit and silently omit an otherwise valid position.
601:                     entry.quantity_changes.append((change["position"].strip(), quantity,
602:                                                    _unit_is_set(change.get("unit"))))
603:             for change in row.get("tech_amendments") or []:
604:                 if _text(change.get("requirement_ref")) and _text(change.get("attribute")) and change.get("value") is not None:
605:                     entry.amendments.append((_text(change.get("revision")) or "", change["requirement_ref"].strip(),
606:                                              change["attribute"].strip(), str(change["value"])))
607:             for assigned in row.get("assignments") or []:
608:                 position = _text(assigned.get("position"))
609:                 if not position:
610:                     continue
611:                 keys = {kind: _text(assigned.get(kind)) for kind in ASSIGNMENT_KINDS if _text(assigned.get(kind))}
612:                 if keys:
613:                     entry.assignments.setdefault(position, {}).update(keys)
614:                 fee = parse_number(assigned.get("ordinary_setup_fee"), assigned.get("number_format"))
615:                 if fee is not None:
616:                     entry.setup_fees[position] = fee
617:             clarifications.append(entry)
618:         # A quantity change can also come by mail (eval variant A: the buyer's request changed one position): it
619:         # counts like a Q&A answer of its date, for exactly this tender reference and not after the scenario date.
620:         for key, row in self.messages.items():
621:             changes = [(str(change["position"]).strip(), _int(change.get("quantity")), None)
622:                        for change in row.get("quantity_changes") or []
623:                        if isinstance(change, dict) and _text(change.get("position")) and _int(change.get("quantity")) is not None]
624:             when = parse_when(row.get("timestamp"))
625:             if (changes and (_text(row.get("tender_reference")) or "").upper() == self.reference.upper()
626:                     and (when is None or when <= self.scenario)):
627:                 clarifications.append(Clarification(f"mail:{key}", when, quantity_changes=changes))
628:         requirements = {}
629:         for (revision, ref), row in self.requirements.items():
630:             if governing and revision and not same_text(revision, governing):
631:                 continue
632:             if not governing and revision:
633:                 continue
634:             requirements[ref] = Requirement(
635:                 ref, _int(row.get("bore_mm")), _int(row.get("stroke_mm")), _int(row.get("pressure_bar")),
636:                 _text(row.get("mounting")), _text(row.get("certification")), _text(row.get("catalogue_group")),
637:                 bool(row.get("stroke_is_usable_travel")), _text(row.get("reserve_key")), _int(row.get("pieces_per_set")))
638:         materials = []
639:         for number, row in self.materials.items():
640:             def grams(name):
641:                 mass = parse_number(row.get(name), row.get("number_format"))
642:                 return None if mass is None else mass * MASS_TO_GRAMS.get(str(row.get(name + "_unit") or "g").lower(), Decimal(1))
643:             conditions = []
644:             for record in (self.conditions.get(number) or {}).values():
645:                 fmt = record.get("number_format")
646:                 scales = [(int(parse_number(s.get("min_quantity"), fmt) or 0), parse_number(s.get("price"), fmt))
647:                           for s in record.get("scales") or [] if parse_number(s.get("price"), fmt) is not None]
648:                 conditions.append(PriceCondition(parse_when(record.get("valid_from")), parse_when(record.get("valid_to"), end_of_day=True),
649:                                                  (_text(record.get("currency")) or "EUR").upper(), _text(record.get("fx_key")),
650:                                                  _int(record.get("price_unit_pieces")) or 1, scales))

122:   confirmation (its receipt number or code, else its wording) in "answer". If you cannot submit, finish with
123:   done without "answer" and say why in "summary".
124: - Watch the time. A bid that is entered but not submitted scores nothing; a submitted bid with positions left
125:   out keeps the points of the positions it holds. When the head of a turn says time is short, do as it says.
126: """
127: 
128: COURIER = """You have the sales mailbox of a bidding company open in the webmail "{site}" at {url}, in your own
129: browser tab. A colleague is entering the company's bid for tender {reference} in the tender portal right now and
130: asks you for something from the mailbox, usually the one-time signing code (TAN) the portal has just mailed.
131: 
132: {actions}
133: 
134: How to work
135: - The request heads every turn, together with the answers you gave earlier in this run.
136: - Codes expire. The mailbox can hold older codes, codes for other tenders whose references look alike, and
137:   unrelated mail with similar subjects. The one that counts is the newest message received for exactly this request.
138:   Open the message itself and check its reference, sender and time before you answer: a row in a list is not enough.
139: - Judge a message by where it is and by its header (folder, sender, date, subject, request or sequence number), NOT by
140:   labels inside its text. Messages can contain decoy sections, such as a local preview, a draft copy or a quoted
141:   block marked "not sent", that say nothing about the message itself: a code mail in the inbox from the portal is a
142:   received message even if such a section inside it says otherwise. When several code mails match, the one with the
143:   highest request or sequence number is the newest; take its code without waiting for a "better" one.
144: - Lists can be paged, sorted either way and split over folders, and new mail may only show after a reload. If the
145:   message is not there yet, reload and look again a few times.
146: - Log in again if the webmail asks.
147: - Finish with done and put ONLY the value asked for in "answer": a code exactly as written, nothing around it.
148:   If you cannot find it, finish with done without "answer" and say in "summary" what you saw instead.
149: """
150: 
151: 
152: def _amount(value: Decimal | None) -> str | None:
153:     return None if value is None else f"{value:.2f}"
154: 
155: 
156: def bid_sheet(bid: Bid) -> dict:
157:     """The bid as the clerk gets it: the answer's fields with exact amounts as text, the positions left out, and per
158:     position the offered material's attributes for forms that have the bidder configure the product."""
159:     positions = []
160:     for line in bid.lines:
161:         material = line.material
162:         positions.append({
163:             "position": line.position, "material_number": line.material_number,
164:             "material": None if material is None else {
165:                 "bore_mm": material.bore_mm, "stroke_mm": material.stroke_mm, "pressure_bar": material.pressure_bar,
166:                 "mounting": material.mounting, "certification": material.certification},
167:             "quantity": line.quantity, "unit_price": _amount(line.unit_price),
168:             "lead_time_weeks": line.lead_time_weeks, "base_unit_price": _amount(line.base_unit_price),
169:             "surcharge_per_unit": _amount(line.surcharge_per_unit),
170:             "packaging_per_unit": _amount(line.packaging_per_unit), "rebate_total": _amount(line.rebate_total)})
171:     discount = Decimal(bid.discount_percent)
172:     return {"tender_reference": bid.tender_reference, "decision": bid.decision, "currency": "EUR",
173:             "discount_percent": int(discount) if discount == discount.to_integral_value() else float(discount),
174:             "positions": positions, "omitted_positions": list(bid.omitted), "total_net": _amount(bid.total_net)}
175: 
176: 
177: async def submit_bid(tender_tab: Tab, mail_tab: Tab | None, bid: Bid, context: dict, brief: str,
178:                      deadline: float) -> dict:
179:     """Have an agent enter, sign and submit `bid` in the tender portal before `deadline` (a time.time() value).
180: 
181:     `context` holds tender_reference, scenario_date, company, vat_id and email. Returns {"submitted", "receipt",
182:     "notes"}: `receipt` is the portal's confirmation as the agent read it, empty when there was none.
183:     """
184:     reference = str(context.get("tender_reference") or bid.tender_reference)
185:     guard = sanity.TypingGuard() if sanity.enabled("typing_guard") else None
186:     codes: list[str] = []
187:     final = {"clicked": False, "page": ""}  # set by finalize once the binding submit button was pressed  # what the mailbox handed out so far: a used code must not be handed out again
188:     review: Report | None = None
189:     held_back = 0  # final steps refused because the page did not show the bid
190: 
191:     # The courier gets a fresh tab in the mailbox's browser (same session), opened now in the background while the
192:     # bid form is filled: the investigators' tab can be left half-navigated by the deadline that stopped them, and
193:     # a cold mailbox costs minutes when the signing code is waiting (sandbox test run 54c78c38).
194:     courier_tab: Tab | None = None
195:     warming = None
196:     if mail_tab is not None:
197:         try:
198:             page = await mail_tab.page.context.new_page()
199:             courier_tab = Tab(page, {"siteId": mail_tab.site_id, "url": mail_tab.base_url,
200:                                      "credentials": mail_tab.credentials})
201:             warming = asyncio.ensure_future(courier_tab.goto(courier_tab.base_url + "/"))
202:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  no second tab: fall back to the investigators' one
203:             courier_tab = mail_tab
204: 
205:     # The control that requested the signing code: clicking it again before a code came back voids the code that is
206:     # on its way (sandbox run a85be021 lost its signature this way). Recorded when the clerk first asks the mailbox.
207:     code_request = {"label": None, "searches": 0, "last_click": None}
208:     omits = {"count": 0, "hints": 0}  # omit controls pressed, and the clerk's circle hints at the last one
209: 
210:     def _label_of(aid) -> str | None:
211:         user = clerk.turns[-1]["user"] if clerk.turns else ""
212:         match = re.search(rf'\[{re.escape(str(aid))}\] [a-z ]*?"([^"]+)"', user)
213:         return match.group(1).strip() if match else None

215:     def clerk_guard(action: dict) -> str | None:
216:         veto = guard(action) if guard is not None else None
217:         if veto:
218:             return veto
219:         # Bounded: after two searches that found nothing the code may really be lost, and a fresh request is allowed.

224:                     "request makes the code already on its way invalid. Ask the mailbox colleague again (ask_mail) "
225:                     "and say exactly what to look for: the newest code mail for this tender.")
226:         if label and bid.decision == "bid" and OMIT_CONTROL.search(label):
227:             stuck_again = clerk.circle_hints > omits["hints"]  # caught going in circles since the last omit
228:             # A position the form adds that is not on the bid sheet (run 9ac58b69: an extra form position) is left
229:             # out as it should be: the cap is only for a page that shows one of the bid's priced positions.
230:             page = str(getattr(tender_tab, "document", "") or "")
231:             priced_here = any(re.search(rf"(?<![\w.]){re.escape(str(line.position))}(?![\w.])", page)
232:                               for line in bid.lines)
233:             if (priced_here and omits["count"] >= len(bid.omitted) + 1 and not stuck_again

235:                 return (f'blocked: "{label}" would leave out a position that has its values on the bid sheet. Only '
236:                         "the one position you were stuck on may be left out. Enter this position with its values "
237:                         "from the bid sheet (all choices with their apply buttons and the amounts in one \"steps\" "
238:                         "action), then move on.")
239:             omits["count"] += 1
240:             omits["hints"] = clerk.circle_hints
241:         if label:
242:             code_request["last_click"] = label  # read from the page the clerk acted on, before the click happens
243:         return None

245:     async def ask_mail(action: dict) -> str:
246:         if code_request["label"] is None:
247:             code_request["label"] = code_request["last_click"]  # the control that asked for the code
248:         code_request["searches"] += 1
249:         task = str(action.get("task") or "").strip()
250:         if not task:
251:             return 'ask_mail needs a "task": say what you need from the mailbox and how to recognise it'
252:         if courier_tab is None:
253:             return "there is no mailbox in this run, so nothing can be fetched by mail"
254:         if warming is not None and not warming.done():
255:             try:
256:                 await asyncio.wait_for(asyncio.shield(warming), 20)
257:             except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001  the courier opens the page itself then
258:                 pass
259: 
260:         def request() -> str:
261:             text = f"REQUEST FROM YOUR COLLEAGUE AT THE TENDER PORTAL\n{task}"
262:             if codes:
263:                 text += ("\n\nANSWERS YOU GAVE EARLIER IN THIS RUN (they are used up: a new request needs a newer "
264:                          "message)\n" + "\n".join(f"- {code}" for code in codes))
265:             return text
266: 
267:         system = COURIER.format(site=courier_tab.site_id, url=courier_tab.base_url, reference=reference,
268:                                 actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
269:         courier = Agent("courier", courier_tab, system, request, deadline=min(deadline, time.time() + MAIL_BUDGET),
270:                         max_steps=COURIER_STEPS, think=COURIER_THINKS, finish_on_repeat=3)
271:         outcome = await courier.run()
272:         answer = str(outcome.get("answer") or "").strip()
273:         if not answer:
274:             return ("the mailbox colleague found nothing: " + (outcome.get("summary") or "no result in the time given")
275:                     + ". Do NOT request a new code yet: a new request makes the current one invalid and costs minutes. "
276:                     "Ask the colleague again first, saying what to look for (the newest code mail for this tender).")
277:         codes.append(answer)
278:         if guard is not None:
279:             guard.allow(answer)  # read from the mailbox during the run: the clerk may type it
280:         return f'the mailbox colleague answers: "{answer}"' + (f' ({outcome["summary"]})' if outcome.get("summary") else "")
281: 
282:     async def look() -> Report:
283:         report = check_review(await tender_tab.observe(), bid, reference)
284:         if report.unproven and not sanity.enabled("summary_check"):  # switched off: missing evidence only warns
285:             report = Report(not report.blockers, report.blockers, report.warnings + report.unproven, report.checks)
286:         return report
287: 
288:     async def check_submission(action: dict) -> str:
289:         nonlocal review
290:         review = await look()
291:         return review.text()
292: 
293:     async def finalize(action: dict) -> str:
294:         nonlocal review, held_back
295:         # Navigation, expiry and server validation can invalidate an earlier review, so inspect it again.
296:         review = await look()
297:         if review.blockers:
298:             return review.text() + "\nFinal submission was not pressed."
299:         if review.unproven:
300:             # The page does not show the bid, so pressing here would confirm something nobody compared. The clerk
301:             # is sent to a page that does show it, a bounded number of times and never when time is short.
302:             short = deadline - time.time() < WRAP_UP
303:             if held_back < UNPROVEN_REFUSALS and not short:
304:                 held_back += 1
305:                 return review.text() + "\nFinal submission was not pressed."
306:             print("[submit] final step pressed without full review evidence ("
307:                   + ("time is short" if short else f"held back {held_back} time(s)") + "): "
308:                   + " | ".join(review.unproven), flush=True)
309:         result = await tender_tab.click(action.get("id"))
310:         # Submitting ends the run and with it the run token: every later model call fails ("expired/unknown run
311:         # token" in sandbox runs 6da03229, 8184b178, 3c3568bb). So the confirmation is read here, in code, and the
312:         # clerk stops without another model turn.
313:         try:
314:             final["page"] = await asyncio.wait_for(tender_tab.observe(), 20)
315:         except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
316:             final["page"] = ""
317:         final["clicked"] = True
318:         clerk.deadline = 0  # ends the agent loop before its next model call
319:         return result
320: 
321:     def heading() -> str:
322:         left = int(deadline - time.time())
323:         text = f"YOUR JOB: enter, sign and submit the bid for tender {reference}, then read the confirmation."
324:         if codes:
325:             text += "\nCodes from the mailbox so far, oldest first: " + ", ".join(codes)
326:         if left < WRAP_UP:
327:             text += (f"\nTIME IS SHORT ({left} s). Enter no further positions: leave out the ones not entered yet if "
328:                      "the form allows it, go straight to the signature, fetch the code and submit what is entered.")
329:         return text

331:     bidder = {"company": context.get("company"), "vat_id": context.get("vat_id"), "email": context.get("email")}
332:     sheet = bid_sheet(bid)
333:     system = CLERK.format(site=tender_tab.site_id, url=tender_tab.base_url, brief=brief, reference=reference,
334:                           bidder=json.dumps(bidder, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1),
335:                           sheet=json.dumps(sheet, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), actions=ACTIONS_HELP)
336:     if sanity.enabled("no_guessed_mailbox") and not bidder.get("email"):
337:         system += ("\nTHE BIDDER'S E-MAIL ADDRESS IS NOT KNOWN YET. If the form asks for it, get it with ask_mail (the "
338:                    "mailbox colleague can read the address of the mailbox it has open) and type exactly that. Never "
339:                    "make up an address, not even a plausible one.\n")
340:     if guard is not None:
341:         guard.allow(sheet)
342:         guard.allow(bidder)
343:         guard.allow(reference)
344:     clerk = Agent("submit", tender_tab, system, heading,
345:                   extra={"ask_mail": ask_mail, "check_submission": check_submission, "finalize": finalize}, deadline=deadline,
346:                   max_steps=CLERK_STEPS, think=CLERK_THINKS, guard=clerk_guard,
347:                   circle_hint=CLERK_CIRCLE_HINT)

354:     if not outcome.get("done"):

1: """A conservative, no-model checklist for the tender portal's review page.
2: 
3: The clerk decides when it has reached a review page.  This module only reports
4: what the accessible page proves.  It tells two things apart:
5: 
6: - blockers: the page shows something wrong (an explicit error, an unfilled
7:   required control).  The final step is never pressed over these.
8: - unproven: the page does not show what a review must show (the tender
9:   reference, every offered position, the calculated total).  A click that
10:   "worked" proves nothing about what the portal holds, so the final step waits
11:   for a page that shows them; `submit.py` bounds that wait, because a signed
12:   bid scores and an unsigned one does not.
13: 
14: It never invents portal-specific field mappings.
15: """
16: from __future__ import annotations
17: 
18: import re
19: from dataclasses import dataclass
20: from decimal import Decimal
21: 
22: from calculator import Bid
23: 
24: ERROR = re.compile(r"\b(error|invalid|failed|missing|fehler|ungültig|pflichtfeld)\b", re.I)
25: EMPTY_REQUIRED = re.compile(r"^(?=.*\(required\))(?=.*(?:value=\"\"|\[unchecked\])).*$", re.I)
26: 
27: 
28: @dataclass(frozen=True)
29: class Report:
30:     ready: bool
31:     blockers: tuple[str, ...]
32:     warnings: tuple[str, ...]
33:     checks: tuple[str, ...]
34:     unproven: tuple[str, ...] = ()
35: 
36:     def text(self) -> str:
37:         state = "READY" if self.ready else "BLOCKED"
38:         lines = [f"PRE-SUBMISSION CHECKLIST: {state}", *[f"- {item}" for item in self.checks]]
39:         lines += [f"- BLOCKER: {item}" for item in self.blockers]
40:         lines += [f"- NOT SHOWN: {item}" for item in self.unproven]
41:         lines += [f"- WARNING: {item}" for item in self.warnings]
42:         if self.unproven:
43:             lines.append("This page does not show the whole bid. Open the form's review or summary step that lists "
44:                          "the reference, every position and the total, compare it with the bid sheet, correct what "
45:                          "differs, and check again there.")
46:         return "\n".join(lines)
47: 
48: 
49: def _money(value: Decimal) -> set[str]:
50:     fixed = f"{value:.2f}"
51:     whole, cents = fixed.split(".")
52:     return {fixed, fixed.replace(".", ","), f"{int(whole):,}.{cents}", f"{int(whole):,}".replace(",", ".") + "," + cents}
53: 
54: 
55: def check(page: str, bid: Bid, reference: str) -> Report:
56:     """Report review-page evidence without assuming a portal's labels or layout."""
57:     visible = re.sub(r"\[\d+\] ", "", page)
58:     lower = visible.lower()
59:     blockers: list[str] = []
60:     unproven: list[str] = []
61:     warnings: list[str] = []
62:     checks: list[str] = []
63:     errors = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if ERROR.search(line)]
64:     required = [line.strip() for line in visible.splitlines() if EMPTY_REQUIRED.match(line)]
65:     if errors:
66:         blockers.append("the portal reports: " + " | ".join(errors[:3])[:500])
67:     else:
68:         checks.append("no explicit portal error is visible")
69:     if required:
70:         blockers.append("a required control is empty or unchecked: " + " | ".join(required[:3])[:500])
71:     else:
72:         checks.append("no empty required control is visible")
73:     if reference and reference.lower() in lower:
74:         checks.append(f"tender reference {reference} is visible")
75:     else:
76:         unproven.append(f"tender reference {reference} is not visible on this page")
77:     expected = [line.position for line in bid.lines]
78:     missing = [position for position in expected if not re.search(rf"(?<![\w.-]){re.escape(position)}(?![\w.-])", visible)]
79:     if missing:
80:         unproven.append("offered position(s) not visible in this review: " + ", ".join(missing))
81:     else:
82:         checks.append("every offered position is visible")
83:     if bid.decision == "bid":
84:         if any(amount in visible for amount in _money(Decimal(bid.total_net))):
85:             checks.append("calculated total is visible")
86:         else:
87:             unproven.append(f"calculated total {Decimal(bid.total_net):.2f} is not visible on this page")
88:         # A unit price the page does not show is a hint for the clerk's own comparison, not proof of a mistake:
89:         # a review may list line totals only.
90:         unpriced = [line.position for line in bid.lines if line.position not in missing and line.unit_price is not None
91:                     and not any(amount in visible for amount in _money(Decimal(line.unit_price)))]
92:         if unpriced:
93:             warnings.append("unit price of the bid sheet not visible for position(s): " + ", ".join(unpriced))
94:         if bid.omitted:
95:             warnings.append("the calculator left out position(s): " + ", ".join(bid.omitted)
96:                             + "; they must not carry invented values")
97:     return Report(not blockers and not unproven, tuple(blockers), tuple(warnings), tuple(checks), tuple(unproven))

1: """Sanity checks against model hallucinations, as switchable plugins. Plain code: no model call, no real cost.
2: 
3: Every check has a name, the stage where it hooks in and a status. `SANITY_CHECKS` picks which run:
4:     unset or "default"   every implemented check
5:     "all"                the same (planned checks are skipped until they exist)
6:     "none"               none of them
7:     "typing_guard,validator"   exactly these
8: so that the same version can be run with and without a check and the scores compared.
9: """
10: from __future__ import annotations
11: 
12: import os
13: import re
14: from dataclasses import dataclass
15: from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation
16: 
17: 
18: @dataclass(frozen=True)
19: class Check:
20:     name: str
21:     stage: str  # where it hooks in
22:     catches: str
23:     implemented: bool
24:     default: bool = True  # on when SANITY_CHECKS is unset; "all" also turns on the ones that are off by default
25: 
26: 
27: REGISTRY: dict[str, Check] = {check.name: check for check in (
28:     Check("validator", "before the bid is entered",
29:           "duplicate or foreign positions, a total that is not the sum of the lines, broken lines", True),
30:     Check("typing_guard", "every value the bid clerk types",
31:           "values that come from nowhere: an invented e-mail, a made-up price, a mistyped number", True),
32:     Check("no_guessed_mailbox", "bidder details handed to the clerk",
33:           "an unknown mailbox address filled in by guessing: the clerk asks the mailbox colleague instead", True),
34:     Check("coverage_gate", "before an agent closes a question",
35:           "a question closed as absent after one search, or closed over a list that stopped at its page limit", True),
36:     Check("agent_restart", "an investigator that stops unfinished",
37:           "an agent that ended at its step limit or in a loop while its questions are still open: one fresh restart "
38:           "(new tab, new conversation) while at least 2 minutes of investigation remain", True),
39:     Check("single_code_request", "the bid clerk's clicks after it asked for the signing code",
40:           "a second code request before the first code came back: it voids the code on its way (run a85be021 "
41:           "lost its signature this way)", True),
42:     Check("grounding", "every fact the extraction returns",
43:           "extracted numbers, keys and identifiers that do not appear in the page they came from", True,
44:           default=False),  # off until a sandbox run shows it helps: it could also drop a value written differently
45:     Check("summary_check", "before the final signature",
46:           "a final confirmation on a page that does not show the bid's reference, positions and total", True),
47:     Check("escalation", "an agent still going in circles after a hint",
48:           "a gate, slider, dead link or covered page the text view hides: one stronger turn (reasoning on, with a "
49:           "screenshot) before the agent is given up on", True),
50: )}
51: 
52: 
53: def enabled(name: str) -> bool:
54:     check = REGISTRY.get(name)
55:     if check is None or not check.implemented:
56:         return False
57:     choice = os.environ.get("SANITY_CHECKS", "default").strip().lower()
58:     if choice in ("", "default"):
59:         return check.default
60:     if choice == "all":
61:         return True
62:     if choice == "none":
63:         return False
64:     return name in {part.strip() for part in choice.split(",")}
65: 
66: 
67: def active() -> list[str]:
68:     return [name for name in REGISTRY if enabled(name)]
69: 
70: 
71: # ---- typing_guard -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
72: 
73: _ZERO_WIDTH = {0x200B, 0x200C, 0x200D, 0x2060, 0xFEFF, 0x00AD}
74: 
75: 
76: def _clean(text) -> str:
77:     return "".join(ch for ch in str(text) if ord(ch) not in _ZERO_WIDTH).strip()
78: 
79: 
80: def _as_number(text: str) -> Decimal | None:
81:     """A typed number in German or English notation ("1.234,56", "1,234.56", "2930,65", "24"), else None."""
82:     raw = _clean(text).replace(" ", "").replace(" ", "")
83:     if not re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?[\d.,]+", raw) or not re.search(r"\d", raw):
84:         return None
85:     if "," in raw and "." in raw:
86:         raw = raw.replace(".", "").replace(",", ".") if raw.rfind(",") > raw.rfind(".") else raw.replace(",", "")
87:     elif "," in raw:
88:         raw = raw.replace(",", ".") if len(raw.rsplit(",", 1)[1]) != 3 else raw.replace(",", "")
89:     elif raw.count(".") > 1:
90:         raw = raw.replace(".", "")
91:     try:
92:         return Decimal(raw)
93:     except InvalidOperation:
94:         return None
95: 
96: 
97: def same_value(typed, shown) -> bool:
98:     """Whether a field shows what was typed, allowing for another number notation ("12.50" and "12,50")."""
99:     first, second = _clean(typed), _clean(shown)
100:     if first.casefold() == second.casefold():
101:         return True
102:     number, other = _as_number(first), _as_number(second)
103:     return number is not None and other is not None and number == other
104: 
105: 
106: def _leaves(value, out: list) -> None:
107:     if isinstance(value, dict):
108:         for item in value.values():
109:             _leaves(item, out)
110:     elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple, set)):
111:         for item in value:
112:             _leaves(item, out)
113:     elif value is not None and value != "":
114:         out.append(value)
115: 
116: 
117: class TypingGuard:
118:     """Allows the clerk to type only what our data holds. `allow()` adds values learned during the run (a code the
119:     mailbox colleague read, an address it found)."""
120: 
121:     def __init__(self, *sources):
122:         self.texts: set[str] = set()
123:         self.numbers: set[Decimal] = set()
124:         for source in sources:
125:             self.allow(source)
126: 
127:     def allow(self, source) -> None:
128:         values: list = []
129:         _leaves(source, values)
130:         for value in values:
131:             text = _clean(value)
132:             if not text:
133:                 continue
134:             self.texts.add(text.casefold())
135:             number = _as_number(text) if not isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)) else Decimal(str(value))
136:             if number is not None:
137:                 self.numbers.add(number.normalize())
138: 
139:     def __call__(self, action: dict) -> str | None:
140:         """None when the action may run, else the reason it is blocked."""
141:         if action.get("do") != "fill":
142:             return None
143:         text = _clean(action.get("text", ""))
144:         if not text:
145:             return None  # clearing a field is always allowed
146:         if text.casefold() in self.texts:
147:             return None
148:         number = _as_number(text)
149:         if number is not None and number.normalize() in self.numbers:
150:             return None
151:         if any(text.casefold() in known or known in text.casefold() for known in self.texts if len(known) >= 6) \
152:                 and number is None:
153:             return None  # the same value with a little extra around it, e.g. a code with its label
154:         return (f'blocked: "{text[:60]}" is not in the bid sheet, the bidder details or anything the mailbox colleague '
155:                 "reported. Type values exactly from that data. If the form asks for something you do not have, ask "
156:                 "the mailbox colleague (ask_mail) or leave the field empty; never make a value up.")
157: 
158: 
159: # ---- grounding ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
160: 
161: # Fields the extraction converts by design (dates to ISO, yes/no, formats, free text): not looked up in the page.
162: _NOT_GROUNDED = {"timestamp", "date", "valid_from", "valid_to", "number_format", "topic", "status", "status_text",
163:                  "description", "note", "summary", "subject", "is_active", "unit_is_set", "stroke_is_usable_travel",
164:                  "unit", "allocation_mass_unit", "surcharge_mass_unit", "price_unit", "currency", "kind"}
165: _SEPARATOR = re.compile(r"(?<=\d)[.,\s'  ](?=\d)")
166: 
167: 
168: def _page_forms(text: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
169:     plain = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", _clean(text)).lower()
170:     return plain, _SEPARATOR.sub("", plain)
171: 
172: 
173: def _in_page(value, forms: tuple[str, str]) -> bool:
174:     plain, digits = forms
175:     if isinstance(value, bool):
176:         return True
177:     if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)):
178:         token = re.escape(str(value))
179:         # a whole number, not a fragment of a longer one ("12" must not match inside "1234")
180:         return bool(re.search(rf"(?<![\d.,]){token}(?![\d])", digits) or re.search(rf"(?<![\d]){token}(?![\d])", plain))
181:     text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", _clean(value)).lower()
182:     if not re.search(r"\d", text):
183:         return True  # only numbers, keys and identifiers are checked: words may be paraphrased by design
184:     pattern = rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(text)}(?![\w])"
185:     squeezed = rf"(?<![\w]){re.escape(_SEPARATOR.sub('', text))}(?![\w])"
186:     return bool(re.search(pattern, plain) or re.search(squeezed, digits))
187: 
188: 
189: def ground(data, page_text: str) -> tuple[object, list[str]]:
190:     """Blanks every extracted number, key or identifier that does not appear in the page it was extracted from.
191:     Returns the data and what was dropped, for the agent's news (it then re-reads the page)."""
192:     forms = _page_forms(page_text)
193:     dropped: list[str] = []
194: 
195:     def walk(node, path: str):
196:         if isinstance(node, dict):
197:             for key, value in list(node.items()):
198:                 if key in _NOT_GROUNDED or value is None:
199:                     continue
200:                 if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
201:                     walk(value, f"{path}.{key}")
202:                 elif not _in_page(value, forms):
203:                     dropped.append(f"{path}.{key}={str(value)[:40]}")
204:                     node[key] = None
205:         elif isinstance(node, list):
206:             for index, item in enumerate(node):
207:                 if isinstance(item, (dict, list)):
208:                     walk(item, f"{path}[{index}]")
209:                 elif item is not None and not _in_page(item, forms):
210:                     dropped.append(f"{path}[{index}]={str(item)[:40]}")
211:                     node[index] = None
212: 
213:     walk(data, "")
214:     return data, dropped

1: # QuoteCraft — from RFQ to bid
2: 
3: A team of model-directed agents that reads a tender across four business websites it has never seen, works out the
4: bid the rules call for, and enters and signs it in the tender portal.
5: 
6: ## How it works
7: 
8: ```
9: task brief ──► model reads it: tender, scenario date, authorized senders
10:                     │
11:    ┌────────────────┼──────────────────┬─────────────────┐
12:    ▼                ▼                  ▼                 ▼
13:  agent            agent              agent             agent        one per website, each in its own browser:
14:  tender portal    supplier portal    ERP               webmail      the model picks every click, search and page
15:    │  keep          │  keep            │  keep           │  keep
16:    └────────────────┴───────┬──────────┴─────────────────┘
17:                             ▼
18:                      shared case file        a model call turns each filed page into typed facts;
19:                             │                the brief's rules yield the open questions all agents see
20:                             ▼
21:                       calculator.py          the bid rules as exact Decimal arithmetic
22:                             ▼
23:                      submission agent        fills the bid form it finds; the mail agent fetches the TAN
24: ```
25: 
26: 1. **Read the brief.** One model call extracts the tender reference, the scenario date, the bidder and which
27:    mailbox the rules authorize for which kind of record.
28: 2. **Investigate in parallel.** One agent per website (`worker.Agent`). Each turn it sees its page as accessible
29:    text with numbered controls (`browser_env.Tab`), plus the case file and its open questions, and answers with
30:    actions: log in, click, fill, select, search, page through a list, download a file, or `keep` the page as
31:    evidence. After every browser action, a stable accessible-page fingerprint reports whether the page visibly
32:    changed, so silent portal failures become recovery hints rather than assumed success. Nothing in the code knows
33:    a URL, a selector or a click path of any website.
34: 3. **File facts.** `keep` hands the page to a second model call that extracts typed records (positions, Q&A
35:    answers, revisions, requirements, materials, price conditions, mail records). `casefile.CaseFile` merges them
36:    and derives what is still unknown. A schema gate rejects malformed extraction envelopes and records before the
37:    merge. Each successful extraction retains its source URL, site agent, document ID,
38:    normalized result, and merge summary in the case-file dump, so later agents can assess contradictory evidence.
39:    A catalogue group found in the specification becomes an ERP question, a key
40:    in a Q&A answer becomes a mailbox question, and so on. Agents finish when their website has nothing left to add.
41: 4. **Calculate.** `calculator.calculate_bid` applies the bid rules of the brief: latest clarification, withdrawn
42:    answers, scoped amendments, usable travel, sets to pieces, price scales, FX, conditional discount, condition
43:    clauses, shared stock, delivery commitments, cartons, pooled setup, project bonus, rounding. A position that
44:    lacks evidence is left out rather than guessed.
45: 5. **Submit.** `submit.submit_bid` gives the bid to an agent on the tender portal, which fills whatever bid form
46:    it finds, asks a mail agent for the signing TAN, and runs a fresh live-page pre-submit report immediately before
47:    the irreversible confirmation. Explicit portal errors and empty required controls block that confirmation.
48: 
49: ## What is model and what is code
50: 
51: | The model decides | Code does |
52: | --- | --- |
53: | where to go, what to search for, which record or document matters | renders the page, carries out the chosen action |
54: | how to pass a popup, access check, login or error page | retries a server error, re-reads the page |
55: | which page is evidence and of what kind | pages through a list the model chose, reads a file it chose |
56: | what a page says (extraction into typed facts) | parses numbers and dates, checks sender, reference and date |
57: | when a search is complete or a record does not exist | arithmetic, rounding, allocation |
58: | how to fill and sign the bid form | — |
59: 
60: No scenario value (reference, material, price, key, login, TAN) appears anywhere in the package.
61: 
62: ## Files
63: 
64: | File | What it does |
65: | --- | --- |
66: | `agent.py` | Entry point: reads the run, starts the site agents, calculates, hands the bid to the submission agent |
67: | `worker.py` | The agent loop: page text in, the model's actions out |
68: | `browser_env.py` | A tab as accessible text (labels, descriptions, tooltips, frames, collapsed sections) and the actions on it |
69: | `casefile.py` | Evidence to typed facts with source provenance, open questions, calculator inputs |
70: | `calculator.py` | The bid rules as Decimal arithmetic |
71: | `submit.py` | Bid entry and signing |
72: | `preflight.py` | Non-model live review-page report that gates final confirmation on explicit errors or required inputs |
73: | `llm.py` | The hosted Qwen through the run's metering proxy: JSON replies, retries, a concurrency cap |
74: | `run.py`, `browsers.py`, `models.py` | The starter kit's plumbing: the run contract, the run's browsers, the hosted models |
75: | `agent.json` | Setup (`uv sync`), run command, four browsers, the hosted `qwen` |
76: | `tests/` | The calculator rule by rule, the page rendering against local fixtures, the plumbing against fakes |
77: 
78: ## Running it
79: 
80: In the sandbox the platform sets everything (`CHALLENGE_API_URL`, `CHALLENGE_RUN_TOKEN`, `CDP_URLS`, `QWEN_*`):
81: 
82: ```sh
83: atira test-run . --challenge rfq
84: ```
85: 
86: On your machine, against the public websites with the scouting logins (nothing counts), with `atira models proxy`
87: running in another terminal:
88: 
89: ```sh
90: python ../tools/local_run.py --no-submit
91: ```
92: 
93: Switches: `AGENT_SKIP_SUBMIT=1` stops before the bid form, `AGENT_SITES=a,b` starts only those site agents,
94: `AGENT_MAX_STEPS` caps an agent's turns, `AGENT_DUMP=<file>` writes the case file as JSON, and
95: `AGENT_TRACE=<folder>` saves each local agent turn (page, decision and result) for investigation.
96: 
97: ```sh
98: uv run python -m unittest discover tests
99: ```

1: """Deterministic bid arithmetic for the RFQ-to-bid challenge.
2: 
3: The agents find and select the evidence; this module only applies the bid rules of the task brief to the structured
4: facts they filed: exact Decimal arithmetic, ROUND_HALF_UP to the cent, largest-remainder cent allocation, marginal
5: bonus bands, shared stock and delivery commitments. It contains no scenario values and never touches a website.
6: """
7: from __future__ import annotations
8: 
9: import math
10: import re
11: from dataclasses import dataclass, field, replace
12: from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
13: from decimal import Decimal, InvalidOperation, ROUND_HALF_UP
14: from fractions import Fraction
15: 
16: CENT = Decimal("0.01")
17: ZERO = Decimal("0")
18: HUNDRED = Decimal("100")
19: 
20: # Mass units to grams and index-rate units to EUR per gram, so any combination the sources use multiplies out.
21: MASS_TO_GRAMS = {"mg": Decimal("0.001"), "g": Decimal(1), "kg": Decimal(1000), "t": Decimal(1000000)}
22: 
23: 
24: def round_cents(value) -> Decimal:
25:     return Decimal(str(value)).quantize(CENT, rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
26: 
27: 
28: def parse_number(raw, number_format: str | None = None) -> Decimal | None:
29:     """A number as written on a page ("1.234,56", "64,853 (en-US)", 12) as a Decimal; None when there is none.
30: 
31:     `number_format` is "de-DE" (decimal comma) or "en-US" (decimal point); an inline tag in `raw` wins. Without
32:     either, the separators decide, and a lone comma is read as a decimal comma, as German sources write it.
33:     """
34:     if raw is None or isinstance(raw, bool):
35:         return None
36:     if isinstance(raw, Decimal):
37:         return raw
38:     if isinstance(raw, (int, float)):
39:         return Decimal(str(raw))
40:     text = str(raw).strip()
41:     tag = re.search(r"(de-DE|en-US)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
42:     fmt = (tag.group(1) if tag else number_format or "").lower()
43:     match = re.search(r"[-+]?\d[\d.,'\s  ]*", text)
44:     if not match:
45:         return None
46:     token = re.sub(r"['\s  ]", "", match.group(0)).rstrip(".,")
47:     try:
48:         if fmt == "en-us":
49:             return Decimal(token.replace(",", ""))
50:         if fmt == "de-de":
51:             return Decimal(token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."))
52:         if "," in token and "." in token:
53:             if token.rfind(",") > token.rfind("."):
54:                 return Decimal(token.replace(".", "").replace(",", "."))
55:             return Decimal(token.replace(",", ""))
56:         if "," in token:
57:             return Decimal(token.replace(",", ".")) if token.count(",") == 1 else Decimal(token.replace(",", ""))
58:         if token.count(".") > 1:
59:             return Decimal(token.replace(".", ""))
60:         return Decimal(token)
61:     except InvalidOperation:
62:         return None
63: 
64: 
65: def parse_when(raw, end_of_day: bool = False) -> datetime | None:
66:     """An ISO 8601 date or timestamp (as the extraction step writes them) as an aware UTC datetime.
67: 
68:     A value without a time is a whole day: its start, or its last microsecond with `end_of_day`, so that validity
69:     periods include both endpoints.
70:     """
71:     if not raw:
72:         return None
73:     text = str(raw).strip()
74:     try:
75:         if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", text):
76:             day = datetime.fromisoformat(text).replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
77:             return day + timedelta(days=1) - timedelta(microseconds=1) if end_of_day else day
78:         when = datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
79:     except ValueError:
80:         german = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\.(\d{1,2})\.(\d{4})(?:[,\s]+(\d{1,2}):(\d{2}))?", text)
81:         if not german:
82:             return None
83:         day, month, year, hour, minute = german.groups()
84:         try:
85:             when = datetime(int(year), int(month), int(day), int(hour or 0), int(minute or 0))
86:         except ValueError:
87:             return None
88:         if hour is None and end_of_day:
89:             when += timedelta(days=1) - timedelta(microseconds=1)
90:     return when.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if when.tzinfo is None else when.astimezone(timezone.utc)
91: 
92: 
93: def allocate_cents(total_cents: int, weights: dict[str, Decimal], method: str = "largest_remainder") -> dict[str, Decimal]:
94:     """Split `total_cents` across the keys in proportion to `weights`, as EUR amounts that sum exactly.
95: 
96:     Every share is floored to the cent; the cents left over go out by `method`: "largest_remainder" (ties to the
97:     lower key), "remainder_to_first", "remainder_to_last" or "remainder_to_largest" (the biggest weight).
98:     """
99:     keys = sorted(weights, key=position_order)
100:     total_weight = sum(weights.values(), ZERO)
101:     if not keys or total_cents <= 0 or total_weight <= 0:
102:         return {key: ZERO for key in keys}
103:     # Exact fractions: a tie between remainders must be a tie, not a matter of decimal precision.
104:     exact = {key: Fraction(total_cents) * Fraction(weights[key]) / Fraction(total_weight) for key in keys}
105:     cents = {key: math.floor(exact[key]) for key in keys}
106:     left = total_cents - sum(cents.values())
107:     if method == "remainder_to_first":
108:         cents[keys[0]] += left
109:     elif method == "remainder_to_last":
110:         cents[keys[-1]] += left
111:     elif method == "remainder_to_largest":
112:         cents[max(keys, key=lambda key: (weights[key], -keys.index(key)))] += left
113:     else:
114:         for key in sorted(keys, key=lambda key: (-(exact[key] - cents[key]), keys.index(key)))[:left]:
115:             cents[key] += 1
116:     return {key: Decimal(cents[key]) * CENT for key in keys}
117: 
118: 
119: def position_order(key) -> list:
120:     """Position identifiers in ascending order: their numbers count as numbers ("2" before "10")."""
121:     return [(0, int(part), "") if part.isdigit() else (1, 0, part) for part in re.findall(r"\d+|\D+", str(key))]
122: 
123:

293: def active_clarifications(clarifications: list[Clarification], scenario: datetime) -> list[Clarification]:
294:     """The answers that count, oldest first: dated no later than the scenario date and not withdrawn by another."""
295:     dated = [c for c in clarifications if c.when is None or c.when <= scenario]
296:     withdrawn = {str(number).strip() for c in dated for number in c.withdraws}
297:     floor = datetime.min.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
298:     return sorted((c for c in dated if c.number.strip() not in withdrawn), key=lambda c: (c.when or floor, c.number))

301: def resolve_requirements(requirements: dict[str, Requirement], governing_revision: str | None,
302:                          answers: list[Clarification], authorities: Authorities) -> tuple[dict[str, Requirement], dict[str, str]]:
303:     """The governing requirements after scoped amendments and the usable-travel derivation.
304: 
305:     Returns them with, per requirement that still waits for a reserve, what it waits for.
306:     """
307:     resolved = {ref: replace(need) for ref, need in requirements.items()}
308:     for answer in answers:  # oldest first, so the latest amendment wins per attribute
309:         for revision, ref, attribute, value in answer.amendments:
310:             need = resolved.get(ref)
311:             if need is None or not governing_revision or not same_text(revision, governing_revision):
312:                 continue
313:             name = attribute.lower()
314:             number = parse_number(value, "de-DE")  # a dot in a German dimension groups thousands
315:             if name in ("stroke", "bore", "pressure") and number is not None:
316:                 setattr(need, {"stroke": "stroke_mm", "bore": "bore_mm", "pressure": "pressure_bar"}[name], int(number))
317:             elif name in ("mounting", "certification"):
318:                 setattr(need, name, str(value).strip())
319:     waiting: dict[str, str] = {}
320:     for ref, need in resolved.items():
321:         if not need.usable_travel or need.stroke_mm is None:
322:             continue
323:         entry = authorities.reserves.get(need.reserve_key or "")
324:         if entry is None and not need.reserve_key:  # the release may name only the revision
325:             bound = [e for e in authorities.reserves.values() if e[0] and same_text(e[0], governing_revision)]
326:             entry = bound[0] if len(bound) == 1 else None
327:         if entry is None or (entry[0] and governing_revision and not same_text(entry[0], governing_revision)):
328:             waiting[ref] = need.reserve_key or "the per-end reserve"
329:             continue
330:         need.stroke_mm += 2 * entry[1]
331:         need.usable_travel = False
332:     return resolved, waiting

335: def final_quantities(positions: list[Position], answers: list[Clarification],
336:                      requirements: dict[str, Requirement]) -> tuple[dict[str, int], list[str]]:
337:     """Each position's quantity in pieces: the tender's, replaced by the latest answer that changes it, sets
338:     converted with the requirement's pieces per set. Also the positions whose set size is unknown."""
339:     raw = {p.position: (p.quantity, p.is_set) for p in positions}
340:     for answer in answers:
341:         for position, quantity, is_set in answer.quantity_changes:
342:             if position in raw:
343:                 raw[position] = (quantity, raw[position][1] if is_set is None else is_set)
344:     pieces, unknown = {}, []
345:     for p in positions:
346:         quantity, is_set = raw[p.position]
347:         need = requirements.get(p.requirement_ref)
348:         if is_set and not p.is_set and (need is None or not need.pieces_per_set):
349:             is_set = False
350:         if is_set:
351:             if need is None or not need.pieces_per_set:
352:                 unknown.append(p.position)
353:                 continue
354:             quantity *= need.pieces_per_set
355:         pieces[p.position] = quantity
356:     return pieces, unknown

361:     exact = [m for m in materials if m.active and m.matches(need)]
362:     grouped = [m for m in exact if need.catalogue_group and same_text(m.catalogue_group, need.catalogue_group)]
363:     return (grouped or exact or [None])[0]

376: def base_price(material: Material, quantity: int, scenario: datetime, authorities: Authorities) -> tuple[Decimal | None, str]:
377:     """The EUR base price per piece: the condition valid on the scenario date, the highest scale reached, the price
378:     unit normalised, converted with the condition's FX key and rounded to the cent."""
379:     valid = [c for c in material.conditions if c.scales and c.valid_on(scenario)]
380:     if not valid:
381:         return None, "no price condition valid on the scenario date"
382:     condition = valid[0]
383:     reached = [scale for scale in condition.scales if scale[0] <= quantity]
384:     if not reached:
385:         return None, "the quantity is below the lowest price scale"
386:     price = max(reached, key=lambda scale: scale[0])[1] / Decimal(condition.price_unit or 1)
387:     if condition.currency.upper() != "EUR":
388:         rate = authorities.fx.get(condition.fx_key or "")
389:         if rate is None:
390:             return None, f"no FX fixing for {condition.fx_key or condition.currency}"
391:         price *= rate
392:     return round_cents(price), ""

395: def calculate_bid(tender_reference: str, scenario: datetime, governing_revision: str | None,
396:                   positions: list[Position], clarifications: list[Clarification],
397:                   requirements: dict[str, Requirement], materials: list[Material], authorities: Authorities,
398:                   no_material: set[str] | None = None) -> Bid:
399:     """Apply the bid rules. `no_material` names the requirements the agents searched without finding an active
400:     match: one of them makes the answer a no_bid. Positions that lack evidence are left out (partial bid)."""
401:     answers = active_clarifications(clarifications, scenario)
402:     needs, waiting = resolve_requirements(requirements, governing_revision, answers, authorities)
403:     quantities, unknown_sets = final_quantities(positions, answers, needs)
404:     assigned, setup_fees = merged_assignments(answers)
405:     notes: list[str] = []
406:     omitted: list[str] = []
407: 
408:     lines: dict[str, Line] = {}
409:     # Every position whose material and quantity are known, priced or not. Shared amounts (setup pool, project bonus,
410:     # pooled stock demand) are split over all their member positions: a member that could not be priced still takes
411:     # its share, so the priced ones do not absorb it (option A, agreed 10 Oct; sandbox run 9c8fe292 put the whole
412:     # pool on one position because the other members were omitted).
413:     known: dict[str, tuple] = {}
414:     for p in sorted(positions, key=lambda p: position_order(p.position)):
415:         need = needs.get(p.requirement_ref)
416:         if need is not None and p.requirement_ref not in waiting and not need.missing():
417:             material = match_material(need, materials)
418:             if material is None and p.requirement_ref in (no_material or set()):
419:                 approved = authorities.discount_percent or ZERO
420:                 conditional = bool(authorities.discount_min_order)
421:                 return Bid(tender_reference, "no_bid", ZERO if conditional else approved, [], ZERO,
422:                            notes=[f"no active material matches requirement {p.requirement_ref} (position {p.position})"])
423:         else:
424:             material = None
425:         if material is not None and quantities.get(p.position, 0) > 0:
426:             known[p.position] = (material, quantities[p.position])
427:         if material is None or quantities.get(p.position, 0) <= 0:
428:             omitted.append(p.position)
429:             notes.append(f"position {p.position}: " + ("set size unknown" if p.position in unknown_sets
430:                                                        else "no quantity" if material is not None
431:                                                        else f"no material resolved for {p.requirement_ref}"))
432:             continue
433:         lines[p.position] = Line(p.position, material.number, quantities[p.position], material=material)
434: 
435:     for line in list(lines.values()):
436:         line.base_unit_price, why = base_price(line.material, line.quantity, scenario, authorities)
437:         if line.base_unit_price is None:
438:             notes.append(f"position {line.position}: {why}")
439:             omitted.append(line.position)
440:             del lines[line.position]
441: 
442:     # The approval's threshold looks at the undiscounted goods value: quantities times EUR base prices.
443:     goods = {key: round_cents(Decimal(line.quantity) * line.base_unit_price) for key, line in lines.items()}
444:     order_value = round_cents(sum((Decimal(l.quantity) * l.base_unit_price for l in lines.values()), ZERO))
445:     discount = authorities.discount_percent or ZERO
446:     if discount and authorities.discount_min_order is not None and order_value < authorities.discount_min_order:
447:         discount = ZERO
448:         notes.append("the conditional discount approval misses its minimum order value")
449:     factor = (HUNDRED - discount) / HUNDRED
450: 
451:     def members(kind: str, defined) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
452:         """Every tender position assigned to each pool or plan, priced or not."""
453:         groups: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
454:         for p in sorted(positions, key=lambda p: position_order(p.position)):
455:             assigned_key = assigned.get(p.position, {}).get(kind)
456:             if assigned_key and assigned_key in defined:
457:                 groups.setdefault(assigned_key, []).append(p.position)
458:         return groups
459: 
460:     def member_goods(key: str) -> Decimal | None:
461:         """Undiscounted goods value of a member, also for one that is not priced; None when it cannot be known."""
462:         if key in goods:
463:             return goods[key]
464:         if key not in known:
465:             return None
466:         material, quantity = known[key]
467:         price, _ = base_price(material, quantity, scenario, authorities)
468:         return None if price is None else round_cents(Decimal(quantity) * price)
469: 
470:     pool_share = {key: ZERO for key in lines}
471:     for pool, keys in members("setup_pool", authorities.pools).items():
472:         fee, method = authorities.pools[pool]
473:         weights = {}
474:         for key in keys:
475:             material, quantity = (lines[key].material, lines[key].quantity) if key in lines else known.get(key, (None, 0))
476:             weights[key] = Decimal(quantity) * ((material.allocation_mass_g if material else None) or ZERO)
477:         if any(weight <= 0 for weight in weights.values()):  # a member's share cannot be known: leave it blank
478:             for key in keys:
479:                 if key in lines:
480:                     lines[key].gaps.append("allocation mass")
481:             continue
482:         for key, share in allocate_cents(int(round_cents(fee) * 100), weights, method).items():
483:             if key in pool_share:
484:                 pool_share[key] += share
485: 
486:     rebate = {key: ZERO for key in lines}
487:     for plan, keys in members("project_bonus", authorities.bonus).items():
488:         values = {key: member_goods(key) for key in keys}
489:         if any(value is None for value in values.values()):  # a member's goods value is unknown: leave it blank
490:             for key in keys:
491:                 if key in lines:
492:                     lines[key].gaps.append(f"project_bonus {plan} member value unknown")
493:             continue
494:         eligible = sum(values.values(), ZERO)
495:         credit = ZERO
496:         for band in authorities.bonus[plan]:
497:             top = eligible if band.upper is None else min(eligible, band.upper)
498:             if top > band.lower:
499:                 credit += (top - band.lower) * band.percent / HUNDRED
500:         shares = allocate_cents(int(round_cents(credit) * 100), values)
501:         for key, share in shares.items():
502:             if key in rebate:
503:                 rebate[key] += share
504: 
505:     demand: dict[str, int] = {}  # pooled per material over every known position, priced or not (rule 15)
506:     for material, quantity in known.values():
507:         demand[material.number] = demand.get(material.number, 0) + quantity
508: 
509:     for key, line in lines.items():
510:         material, quantity, keys = line.material, Decimal(line.quantity), assigned.get(key, {})
511:         unassigned = [kind for kind in ("packaging_tariff", "setup_pool", "project_bonus", "delivery_commitment",
512:                                         "condition_group") if keys.get(kind) and keys[kind] not in
513:                       {"packaging_tariff": authorities.tariffs, "setup_pool": authorities.pools,
514:                        "project_bonus": authorities.bonus, "delivery_commitment": authorities.commitments,
515:                        "condition_group": authorities.clauses}[kind]]
516:         line.gaps.extend(f"{kind} {keys[kind]}" for kind in unassigned)
517: 
518:         surcharge = ZERO  # the mass surcharge per piece, unrounded
519:         if material.index_code:
520:             rate = authorities.index_rates.get(material.index_code)
521:             if rate is None or material.surcharge_mass_g is None:
522:                 line.gaps.append(f"metal index {material.index_code}")
523:             else:
524:                 surcharge = material.surcharge_mass_g * rate
525:         setup = setup_fees.get(key, ZERO) + pool_share[key]
526: 
527:         cartons = ZERO
528:         if keys.get("packaging_tariff") in authorities.tariffs:
529:             if material.carton_size:
530:                 cartons = Decimal(math.ceil(line.quantity / material.carton_size)) * authorities.tariffs[keys["packaging_tariff"]]
531:             else:
532:                 line.gaps.append("carton size")
533: 
534:         clause = authorities.clauses.get(keys.get("condition_group") or "", "base_only")
535:         base = line.base_unit_price * (factor if clause in ("base_only", "base_and_surcharge") else 1)
536:         mass = surcharge * (factor if clause == "base_and_surcharge" else 1)
537:         line.unit_price = round_cents(base + mass + (setup + cartons - rebate[key]) / quantity)
538: 
539:         blocked = " ".join(line.gaps)
540:         line.surcharge_per_unit = None if "metal index" in blocked or "setup_pool" in blocked or "allocation mass" in blocked \
541:             else round_cents(surcharge + setup / quantity)
542:         line.packaging_per_unit = None if "packaging_tariff" in blocked or "carton size" in blocked \
543:             else round_cents(cartons / quantity)
544:         line.rebate_total = None if "project_bonus" in blocked else round_cents(rebate[key])
545: 
546:         pooled = demand[line.material_number]
547:         commitment = authorities.commitments.get(keys.get("delivery_commitment") or "")
548:         if commitment and same_text(commitment.material, line.material_number) and (
549:                 commitment.max_quantity is None or pooled <= commitment.max_quantity):
550:             line.lead_time_weeks = commitment.weeks

553:         else:
554:             line.lead_time_weeks = material.production_lead_weeks

556:                 line.gaps.append("stock")
557:         if line.lead_time_weeks is None:

2: 
3: Every field of the answer scores on its own, but a few mistakes cost more than their own field: an extra or duplicate
4: position costs a whole position's share, a total that is not the sum of the lines loses the total and the arithmetic
5: points, and a malformed answer is rejected while the clock keeps running. `check` repairs what can be repaired
6: without guessing (duplicates, positions the tender does not have, a total that does not add up, impossible values)

15: CENT = Decimal("0.01")

17: 
18: def _cents(value: Decimal) -> Decimal:

22: def check(bid: Bid, tender_positions: set[str] | None = None) -> tuple[Bid, list[str]]:
23:     """The bid, repaired where that needs no guess, and a list of what was wrong."""
24:     issues: list[str] = []
25:     if bid.decision not in ("bid", "no_bid"):
26:         issues.append(f'decision "{bid.decision}" is neither bid nor no_bid; using bid')
27:         bid.decision = "bid"
28:     if not (Decimal(0) <= bid.discount_percent <= Decimal(100)):
29:         issues.append(f"discount {bid.discount_percent} % is out of range; using 0")
30:         bid.discount_percent = Decimal(0)
31: 
32:     if bid.decision == "no_bid":
33:         if bid.lines or bid.total_net != 0:
34:             issues.append("a no_bid carries no positions and a total of 0; cleared them")
35:             bid.lines, bid.total_net = [], Decimal(0)
36:         return bid, issues
37: 
38:     kept: list[Line] = []
39:     seen: set[str] = set()
40:     known = {p.strip() for p in tender_positions} if tender_positions else None
41:     for line in bid.lines:
42:         key = line.position.strip()
43:         if key in seen:
44:             issues.append(f"position {key} appears twice; kept the first (a duplicate costs a position's share)")
45:             continue
46:         if known is not None and key not in known:
47:             issues.append(f"position {key} is not in the tender; dropped it (an extra position costs a share)")
48:             continue
49:         problem = _line_problem(line)
50:         if problem:

8:   closed on this website until the rest is read;

10:   hits covers that search term in that place and nothing more.

32: 
33: def _short(address: str) -> str:
34:     """An address without its host: the agent works one website."""
35:     parts = urlparse(address)
36:     return (parts.path or "/") + (f"?{parts.query}" if parts.query else "") + (f"#{parts.fragment}" if parts.fragment else "")

40:     def __init__(self):
41:         self.views: dict[str, str] = {}  # address -> title, in the order of the first visit
42:         self.queries: list[tuple[str, str]] = []  # (address, text typed), each once
43:         self.lists: list[ListRun] = []
44:         self.moves = 0  # browser actions that visibly changed the page
45:         self.refused: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}  # question -> (refusals so far, size of the record at the last)
46: 
47:     # ---- written by the agent loop ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
48: 
49:     def saw(self, page: str) -> None:
50:         """A page as the agent read it: its first lines carry the address and the title."""
51:         address = re.match(r"url: (\S+)", page or "")
52:         if address and address.group(1) not in self.views:
53:             title = re.search(r"^title: (.*)$", page, re.M)
54:             self.views[address.group(1)] = title.group(1).strip()[:60] if title else ""
55: 
56:     def typed(self, where: str, text) -> None:
57:         text = " ".join(str(text or "").split())
58:         if text and (where, text.casefold()) not in {(place, query.casefold()) for place, query in self.queries}:
59:             self.queries.append((where, text))
60: 
61:     def followed(self, run: dict | None) -> None:
62:         """How `Tab.collect` ended (its `last_collect`)."""
63:         if run:
64:             self.lists.append(ListRun(str(run.get("where", "")), str(run.get("control", "")),
65:                                       int(run.get("pages") or 0), bool(run.get("capped"))))
66: 
67:     def moved(self) -> None:
68:         self.moves += 1
69: 
70:     # ---- read by the gate ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
71: 
72:     def size(self) -> int:
73:         return len(self.views) + len(self.queries) + len(self.lists) + self.moves
74: 
75:     def incomplete(self) -> list[ListRun]:
76:         """Lists whose last run stopped at the page limit. Following the same control to its end clears it."""
77:         latest: dict[str, ListRun] = {}
78:         for run in self.lists:
79:             latest[run.control] = run
80:         return [run for run in latest.values() if run.capped]
81: 
82:     def report(self) -> str:
83:         pages = [f'"{title}" {_short(address)}' if title else _short(address) for address, title in self.views.items()]
84:         typed = [f'"{text[:60]}" at {_short(where)}' for where, text in self.queries]
85:         lists = [f'"{run.control}" from {_short(run.where)}: {run.pages} page(s), '
86:                  + ("STOPPED AT THE PAGE LIMIT" if run.capped else "to the end") for run in self.lists]
87:         return "\n".join(f"- {label} ({len(items)}): " + ("; ".join(items[-SHOWN:]) or "none") for label, items in (
88:             ("pages opened", pages), ("text typed into search and other fields", typed),
89:             ("lists followed page by page", lists)))

92:         """None when the question may be closed as `status`, else what is missing."""
